jobs.company: Community Youth Center of San Francisco
jobs.title: Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers
jobs.description:
**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**

The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.  
  
**Title:****Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers**

**Salary:****$30.00 - $34.00 per hour plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Program Supervisor**

**Status:****Full-Time, (40 hours/week), Non-Exempt**  
  
**Program Summary:** CYC’s YAWL Workforce Development Program provides job readiness and employment support services to youth ages 16-24. The program offers 1:1 job search and career coaching, work based learning internships, college and career exploration, and job shadowing opportunities to propel youth and young adults to be ready for college, work and reach productive adulthood.  
  
**Position Description:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the Young Adult Job Center portfolio, supervising staff, overseeing workshops/trainings, establishing best practice program models, and providing high quality youth workforce and development services.  
  
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Young Adult Work Link program and comprehensive service delivery model.
* Develop policy and procedure recommendations to strengthen the program model and collaboration among grantee and coalition partners.
* Ensure program development and service delivery align with “Youth Program Quality Standards” and meet all “Work Plan” deliverables and deadlines.
* Complete all required documentation, reports, and program deliverables in a timely manner.
* Lead citywide outreach and recruitment efforts, cultivating strategic community partnerships and developing a robust referral network to support recruitment and engagement, with a focus on priority populations.
* Conduct participant assessments and provide intensive case management, wraparound supportive services, and guidance to address barriers affecting work and school performance.
* Develop individualized vocational goals and career plans using vocational and interest assessments, and provide personal and career guidance.
* Develop and facilitate job readiness training workshops, including but not limited to professionalism, career exploration, resume and cover letter building, job search/navigation, interview skill development, mock interviews, and strength/talent identification.
* Coordinate GED attainment, tutoring, basic skills remediation, postsecondary education, and workforce training services.
* Provide 1:1 career guidance and assist participants with individualized education and career planning services, job search and placement assistance and conduct follow ups for retention services.
* Connect participants to resources within CYC and other CBO or city services for barrier removal to ensure their success.
* Supervise, support, coach and train Program Specialists in job readiness training content, career counseling, outreach, funder databases, and other duties as applicable.
* Collaborate with the workforce team to strategize on program planning, development and implementation of overall youth workforce development programs and outcomes.
* Coordinate career exploration events and adult mentoring opportunities such as worksite/company tours, college tours, and networking events for program participants
* Cultivate relationships with employers, developing jobs for youth and young adults.
* Support agency-wide events and perform other duties as assigned by management.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field.
* Experience working with diverse youth backgrounds, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Previous experience in program coordination and development.
* Ability to work with ethnically diverse groups of low-income youth as well as English learners to support their social and emotional needs during transition.
* At least 1 year of experience supervising a team of three or more staff.
* Experience working with San Francisco's diverse communities and neighborhoods.
* Experience working with community-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other technology platforms.
* Experience facilitating workshops for youth and young adults.
* Ability to work as part of a team, to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a high-pressure environment.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin/Spanish and English is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college education.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs

CYC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, age, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other basis recognized by federal, state, or local law, including on the basis of the intersection of two or more protected characteristics, also known as intersectional discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

jobs.title: Mobile Senior Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:** Under the direction of the Senior Program Manager, the Mobile Senior Services Coordinator plays a proactive role in assisting active and at-risk seniors in accessing and receiving social services that will enable them to remain independent and well supported at Housing sites designated to this program. This position serves seniors and adults with disabilities living in various housing sites in San Francisco by: providing social services, wellness activities, referrals and support In addition, applicants must be able to provide direct administrative and operational support. Candidates must be able to oversee volunteers that provide activities or paid instructors that provide zoom or onsite classes. This position is characterized by a high degree of initiative, strong organization, outreach skills, demonstrated follow-up and follow-through skills, and an ability to work with a diverse group of staff, community members, and community partners. The position also requires proficient computer skills and strong verbal and written communication ability.

**The Organization:** Bernal Heights Neighborhood Center (BHNC) is a non-profit community based multi-service agency founded in 1978. Our mission is “…to preserve and enhance the ethnic, cultural, and economic diversity of Bernal Heights and surrounding neighborhoods. We promote community action to build a just and equitable community for all. BHNC focuses on the needs of people with low and moderate incomes. We work to accomplish our mission by:

* Developing affordable housing throughout San Francisco;
* Providing linguistically and culturally responsive services to our community’s most vulnerable adults, seniors, youth, and their families;
* Developing leaders; organizing and empowering our tenants, clients, members, and allies to advocate for their needs and for the needs of the community.

BHNC has five key program areas to meet this mission: Housing Development and Rehabilitation, Senior Programs, Youth Programs, Employment Programs and Community Organizing. We serve a thousand youth, adults and seniors annually from our offices in Bernal Heights and the Excelsior. Our programs raise funds from the public sector, housing development and management, foundations, local businesses and individuals.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Complete intakes and assessments for incoming participants for the Active Senior Program and completed data entry electronically using the DAAS GetCare system.
* Complete participant charting, monthly reports, and other documentation as required by BHNC and funding sources
* Provide direct short-term social services such as: completing applications, translations, reviewing correspondence, information and referrals for a variety of services and arranging for care and other services needed for participants who attend the senior center
* Evaluate client needs, follow-up and document progress notes to ensure quality and effective service delivery for participants
* Provide administrative support and assistance during programming for activities, field trips, newsletters, translations, etc.
* Provide outreach to frail at risk elders and disabled adults with low incomes at the sites to encourage participation
* Schedules and coordinates meetings with the advisory board and assists in outreach to increase members on the board
* Assist in the implementation of schedules and duties for instructors whether volunteer or paid.
* Work with property management to resolve or assist clients with needs at the housing sites
* Maintains comprehensive records on the selection, training and activities of volunteers
* Provides recommendations for improvements and alterations of the program as needed
* Responds to public inquiries to provide information on the volunteer programs offered at BHNC
* Attend all BHNC meetings, events and activities as requested. Participation in meetings including: monthly Senior Staff, BHNC Staff, and advisory committee meetings
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:**

* Two year prior experience working with seniors and disabled adults preferred
* One year prior experience outreach, engagement, community work preferred
* Experience with Microsoft Office Programs required, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint
* Experience with Google Suite required, including but not limited to Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Google Drive, Google Calendar and Google Forms
* Experience with Slack preferred
* Experience with Asanapreferred
* Experience or desire to learn data entry into DAS GetCare database
* Ability to work in an active setting with staff and volunteers
* Ability to work a schedule from 9:00am-5:00pm on Monday - Friday
* Ability to provide excellent customer service
* Ability to interact with and positively engage people of various social, ethnic, cultural, linguistic, religious, economic and educational backgrounds
* Demonstrates awareness and ability to address the cultural needs of targeted population
* Ability to perform simple addition and subtraction; copying figures, counting, and recording.
* Ability to observe and troubleshoot issues
* Ability to deal with multiple tasks and prioritize accordingly
* Desire and ability to work as a member of a team
* Ability to maintain confidential and sensitive information
* Strong organizational skills with attention to details, consistently able to follow up and follow through on assignments
* Ability to lead with initiative
* Strong sense of accountability and responsibility
* Ability to adapt to changes in a highly energetic work environment.
* Respond effectively and efficiently to all emergency and disciplinary situations

Under direct supervision, serves as a primary support and case manager for individuals with mental illness and other co-occurring disorders by assisting them to live as independently as possible in their chosen community. Case Manager III is distinguished from Case Manager II by the additional education, years of experience, and ability to proficiently perform the job functions and meet position standards.

**About Handshake**
===================

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. **Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

**About The Role**
==================

Handshake is building the enablement function that helps our revenue teams sell, retain, and grow customers more effectively. As Revenue Enablement Manager, you'll design and run the training, content, tools, and onboarding programs that equip our Account Executives, Account Managers, and CSMs to execute consistently against our go-to-market motion. This is a new, high-visibility role where you'll partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to tie enablement directly to pipeline, retention, and revenue outcomes.

**In this role, you will:**

* Design onboarding programs, ramp plans, certifications, and role-play practice that get new AEs, AMs, and CSMs to productivity faster
* Build playbooks, battlecards, objection-handling guides, and talk tracks with Product Marketing and Sales leadership to improve win rates and keep messaging consistent
* Partner with Revenue Operations to analyze Salesforce and Gong data, pinpoint skill gaps, and launch targeted coaching that lifts quota attainment
* Own the enablement calendar and tooling (Salesforce, Nooks, Gainsight, Gong, LMS/content hub) to keep the field current on releases, positioning, and process, and able to find the right resource at every deal stage

**Desired Capabilities**
========================

* 2–5+ years in sales enablement, revenue enablement, sales training, RevOps, or a related GTM role, ideally in B2B SaaS (client-facing experience counts toward this)
* Track record designing and running onboarding, certification, or ongoing training for sales or CS teams
* Experience developing playbooks, battlecards, talk tracks, and case studies with product marketing or sales leadership
* Hands-on CRM proficiency (Salesforce preferred)
* Familiarity with conversation-intelligence and sales engagement platforms (Gong, Outreach, Nooks)
* Comfort pulling and interpreting enablement and pipeline metrics to show program impact and reprioritize
* Strong facilitator and communicator who can run live and virtual sessions and execute projects independently
* Operator mindset: you tie every program to a metric (ramp time, win rate, retention)
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

***Extra Credit***
------------------

* Experience supporting both new-business (AE) and post-sale (AM/CSM) motions
* Prior experience standing up an enablement function or program from the ground up
* Enablement certifications (e.g., CSTM, Sales Enablement PRO)

jobs.description:
The Project Manager reports to the Director, Capital Program Delivery, and is responsible for developing, managing, and administering assigned Mid-range to small rail projects from design through construction phase for the Peninsula Corridor Joint Powers Board (Caltrain)Essential Functions & Duties:

* Develop and manage the scope, schedule, and budget of Caltrain capital projects ensuring alignment with organizational goals and project objectives
* Responsible for the project lifecycle from project planning, design, procurement, construction, integration, commissioning, and closeout.
* Develop and maintain the project execution plan for assigned projects which will be part of the PMP during planning phase and updated during each phase of the project.
* Manage and coordinate all resources necessary to deliver assigned projects, including cross function departments within Rail and external consultants, Resident Engineers, construction management staff, contractors, third parties and regulatory agencies throughout the project.
* Ensure safety first and always core value is implemented through life cycle of project delivery.
* Work closely with the assigned project engineer to ensure that all deliverables are compliant with Caltrain standards.
* Acts as liaison with internal and external stakeholders for assigned projects.
* Acts as the Point of Contact with internal and external stakeholders for assigned projects. Manage coordination and communications with all involved parties, including other agencies, third parties and tenant railroads
* Provide board and executive level reporting on project status, performance metrics and critical risks.
* Manage the Designer of Record and Construction Contractor to ensure delivery of the assigned projects.
* Oversee Project contract administration, change management and claim avoidance to protect Caltrain’s interest.
* Investigate, negotiate, and resolve project issues. Identify the root cause of problems and present appropriate solutions. Escalate issues to the Delivery Directors accordingly to ensure timely resolutions.

**Examples of Essential Duties:**

* Represent assigned Caltrain projects at meetings, including monthly internal project reviews.
* Perform project management duties: develop and maintain project Management plan which includes the scope of work, project staffing plan with clear roles and responsibilities; process workflow of the tasks within the project team and with stakeholders, invoice approval workflow, design review workflow, etc.
* Partner with Project Engineer and construction management in preparation and review of cost estimates; monitor and produce status reports, schedules, and budgets; monitor work in progress; approve, negotiate, and execute, funding agreements and consultant contracts, authorizing contract payments per contract.
* Collaborate with Contracts and Procurement for different procurements required for the JPB, including Professional Services (work directives) and Contract Operator Support Construction Procurement.
* Work with Project Scheduler to create Work Break Down structure and resource load project schedule
* Responsible for reporting project risk.
* Manage Consultant Design team.
* Prepare project reports and presentations for Management, the Board of Directors, and other stakeholders on assigned projects.
* Negotiate and resolve project issues.
* Work closely with the assigned project engineer to ensure all deliverables are compliant with Caltrain standards.
* Work collaboratively with key stakeholders to represent Caltrain for assigned projects.
* Performs all job duties and responsibilities in a safe manner to protect one’s self, fellow employees and the public from injury or harm. Promote safety awareness and follow safety procedures in an effort to reduce or eliminate accidents.

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil engineering or construction management or related field
* Three(3) years full-time experience in project management of construction projects

jobs.title: CX Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

**About the role**
------------------

Grüns is scaling fast, and our customer experience has to scale with it. As CX Operations Manager, you'll own the systems behind how our support team learns, performs, and improves: the knowledge base, training, QA, and the data that shows us where to act next. You'll partner with our BPO leadership and our AI Lead to make every agent sharper and every customer interaction faster and better.

---------------------------

* Dig into CSAT, NPS, QA, FCR, and AHT data to find gaps in workflows and knowledge, then turn them into specific fixes
* Partner with our internal QA team and BPO leadership on calibrations, 1:1 coaching, and performance improvement plans, serving as the liaison between support leadership and agents

----------------------------------

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

PagerDuty is seeking an AI-Forward **Sr. Product & Design Operations Manager** to join our diverse, customer-focused team! As Product & Design Operations Manager, you will be a strategic partner to Product and Design Leadership, building the operating system that lets both functions plan with rigor, launch with confidence, and improve continuously.

In this pivotal role, you will define how product work is scoped, planned, prioritized, tracked, and released — establishing the planning discipline, cross-functional launch mechanisms, and customer feedback loops that turn intent into delivered outcomes. You will partner with Engineering, Finance, and Customer Success to bring structure to how significant changes reach our customers, and you will use agentic tools to build intelligent workflows, and custom AI skills.

This is an exciting opportunity to transform how PagerDuty's product organization operates, innovates, and delivers business value in the age of AI. The ideal candidate is a forward-thinking operator with expertise in product operations, working knowledge of design and research practices, and a proven track record of building products and processes for teams.

**Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant.**

We are looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to build and run the systems, data, and processes behind Samba’s marketing engine. In this role, you will own our marketing technology stack, keep our data clean and trustworthy, and make sure every lead, campaign, and dollar can be traced from first touch to closed-won revenue. You will serve as the bridge between marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and finance, so that every team works from the same numbers and the same definitions.

If you love building systems that scale, untangling messy data, and giving teams reports they can trust, this role is for you.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Technology Stack Management**
-------------------------------

* **Platform Administration:** Own HubSpot as the marketing team’s system of record, including properties, workflows, lists, forms, email deliverability, user permissions, and governance standards.
* **Tool Integration:** Connect HubSpot and the wider marketing stack to Salesforce and other tools (website, webinar and event platforms, paid media channels, data enrichment), and monitor sync health so data moves reliably between systems.
* **Vendor Management:** Evaluate new software, run pilots, negotiate contracts and renewals with procurement and finance, and remove “shelfware” that team members don’t use.
* **Stack Roadmap:** Maintain a documented map of the marketing stack (owners, costs, renewal dates, integrations) and plan where it should go next, including AI and automation tools that help a lean team move faster.

**Data, Analytics & Attribution**
---------------------------------

* **Lead Scoring & Routing:** Build and maintain fit and engagement scoring models and routing logic so high-intent leads reach the right salespeople quickly, with clear follow-up SLAs across regions.
* **Attribution Modeling:** Set up multi-touch attribution models that show which marketing channels (events, content, paid ads, partners, and more) sourced, influenced, and closed deals.
* **Database Hygiene:** Clean up duplicate and incomplete records, set data standards and enrichment rules, ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, and other regional laws), and manage opt-in/opt-out lists and subscription preferences.
* **Account-Based Data:** Support account-based marketing by maintaining target account lists, account-level engagement scoring, and intent signals across HubSpot and Salesforce.

**Campaign & Process Optimization**
-----------------------------------

* **Lifecycle Marketing:** Standardize the funnel stages (Lead ➔ MQL ➔ SQL ➔ Opportunity ➔ Closed-Won) with clear definitions, entry and exit criteria, and handoff rules, so sales and marketing speak the same language.
* **Campaign Operations:** Own campaign setup standards, including UTM conventions, naming taxonomy, HubSpot campaign objects, and Salesforce campaign hierarchy, so every program is tracked consistently from launch.
* **A/B Testing Frameworks:** Set up clean tracking for marketing experiments across email, landing pages, and paid media, with agreed success metrics and sample sizes, so teams can trust their test results.
* **Playbook Creation:** Document internal processes, from campaign launch checklists to lead management rules, so the marketing team can scale without losing efficiency.
* **Global Operations:** Build processes that work across regions (Americas, EMEA, APAC), including localized forms, regional consent requirements, and routing for international teams.

**Alignment & Reporting**
-------------------------

You serve as the vital bridge between marketing, Sales Operations, and finance.

* **Revenue Operations (RevOps):** Partner with RevOps and Sales Ops so data flows from a marketing click to a closed-won contract, with shared definitions and a single source of truth for pipeline.
* **Funnel & Pipeline Reporting:** Build dashboards for marketing, sales leadership, and executives covering MQL volume, stage conversion rates, speed to lead, marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline, and closed-won revenue.
* **Channel Reporting:** Track performance across paid media, email, website, social, events, and content, from spend and engagement to the leads and pipeline each channel produces.
* **Budget & ROI:** Partner with finance to track spend against budget and report on CAC, cost per MQL, cost per opportunity, and ROI by channel and campaign.
* **Planning & Enablement:** Support annual and quarterly planning with funnel math tied to pipeline targets, run weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting reviews, and train marketing and sales teams on HubSpot and reporting.

### **WHO YOU ARE**

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, or marketing technology, ideally in B2B SaaS, data, or media.
* Expert-level HubSpot administration skills; HubSpot certifications are a plus.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience, including the HubSpot–Salesforce integration, campaign objects, and lead and contact management.
* A track record of building lead scoring, routing, and lifecycle stage frameworks that sales teams adopted.
* Working knowledge of attribution models (first-touch, last-touch, multi-touch) and the trade-offs between them.
* Familiarity with GDPR, CCPA, and consent management in a global marketing database.

**About the role**
------------------

As Revenue Operations Manager for Enterprise GTM, you will own the measurement layer of our go-to-market engine. You will be the key to what is in the pipeline, what is converting, what is slipping, and, most importantly, why, and the . Your primary customers are our enterprise new logo and expansion teams across healthcare and life sciences, financial and professional services, TMT and energy, and public sector.

We treat go-to-market as an engineered system. Architecture and design sit with the Director you report to. Instrumentation, measurement, and diagnosis sit with you.

This is an individual contributor role with a wide mandate and real exposure. You will not manage a team. You will own numbers that go to the VP of Enterprise GTM, the executive staff, and the board.

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Own the enterprise reporting layer**

* Build and maintain dashboards that give real-time visibility into pipeline health, stage conversion, sales velocity, coverage ratios, and attainment against plan, cut by vertical, segment, and rep.
* Establish a single agreed definition for every core metric (pipeline created, qualified pipeline, coverage multiple, win rate, cycle time, ACV, committed vs. consumed) and defend it. One number, one source, one definition.
* Report bookings, recognized revenue, and consumption as the distinct measures they are, and make the bridge between them legible to people who do not live in the model.
* Run the operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls in Salesforce and Clari, MBRs, QBRs, and the enterprise section of board reporting.
* Build stakeholder-specific, self-serve views so vertical leaders, sales development, and partnerships can answer their own routine questions without opening a ticket with you.

### **Turn the data into insight**

* Answer the hard "why" questions, e.g., why Stage 3 conversion dropped in financial services, which sourcing motions produce the highest-ACV enterprise deals, where multi-year agreements stall in legal review.
* Build leading indicators and early-warning triggers so leadership sees a coverage or velocity problem 60 days out rather than in the last week of the quarter.
* Pressure-test the forecast. Deliver an independent bottoms-up call and be willing to disagree with the field's number in front of senior leaders.
* Diagnose where to reallocate capacity, headcount, and pipeline generation effort across verticals, and bring the recommendation, not just the chart.
* Produce the analysis behind strategic bets: segmentation changes, territory restructuring, pricing and packaging shifts, new vertical entry.

### **Instrument the funnel and the systems that feed it**

* Own top-of-funnel reporting for Sales Development: lead conversion loops, sourced vs. influenced pipeline, meeting-to-opportunity rates, and adherence to the Sales Development Playbook.
* Champion CRM data integrity. Set and enforce completeness standards for qualification fields, next steps, close dates, and competitive tags. No insight survives a dirty pipeline.
* Work hands-on in the GTM stack: Salesforce, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Clay.
* Partner with GTM Engineering to automate reporting and enrichment, and use AI aggressively to compress your own analysis cycle, e.g., signal-based enrichment, automated variance commentary, first-draft narratives for business reviews.

### **Support planning and compensation**

* Support the Director of Enterprise GTM Architecture through annual and quarterly planning: capacity modeling, territory design, headcount planning, and quota setting.
* Partner with Finance and Legal on the design and modeling of Enterprise and Sales Development commission plans, and own the reporting that tracks whether those plans are driving the intended behavior.

  

**Who you are**
---------------

* **8+ years** in revenue operations, sales operations, GTM strategy, or a highly quantitative business operations role at a high-growth B2B SaaS, PaaS, or AI infrastructure company. Time in management consulting, investment banking, or PE counts toward this when paired with in-house operating experience.
* **Analytically hands-on.** Deep Salesforce reporting fluency, strong command of at least one BI layer (Looker, Hex, Tableau, Sigma), and comfort writing SQL against a warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks). You build the analysis yourself.
* **Enterprise sales fluency.** You know pipeline coverage math cold, you have worked inside a stage-gate qualification framework such as MEDDIC, and you understand what actually moves a seven-figure, multi-threaded, multi-year deal.
* **A track record of reporting people use.** You have built dashboards that changed decisions, not dashboards that nobody opens. You can tell the difference and you optimize for the former.
* **Structured under ambiguity.** You can take a vague, badly-posed question, structure it from scratch, find the root cause, and build a system that keeps it from recurring.
* **Commercially and technically curious.** You will need to speak credibly about our AI products, our differentiators, and the objections enterprise buyers raise around deployment, security, and data.
* **Persuasive with executives.** You can challenge the field's forecast with data in a room of senior leaders and keep the relationship intact.
* **Genuinely interested in using AI to do this job better,** not just to report on selling it.

* Experience supporting regulated verticals (healthcare and life sciences, financial services) or public sector, where procurement cycles and compliance gates distort the funnel.
* Experience standing up reporting for a sales development organization from scratch.

At The Trium Group, we are trusted strategists and advisors to CEOs and senior leaders of some of the world’s most consequential companies. Join our team for the opportunity to work with esteemed business leaders on the front lines of the most transformative strategy and leadership work in the world.

We are seeking a talented Operations Manager to join our team in the San Francisco Bay Area. This role is deeply involved in client relationships while handling the logistics of consulting and coaching engagements, client offsites, and business development. You will support two Partners, a senior client-facing Partner and Trium's Founder & Chairman, and you will work directly with highly skilled consulting practitioners through the entire business development and delivery process of their work.

This is a particularly exciting time in Trium's history as we are celebrating more than 27 years of successful client engagements and thought leadership. If you are looking for a place where you can make a huge impact, where each member of the team is constantly bringing their A-game, and where you will be perpetually challenged to grow and evolve personally and professionally, The Trium Group is the place for you.

### What We Are Looking For

* 6-10 years' experience in executive administrative or project management roles
* Exposure to strategy, business development, and high-profile external stakeholders at the C-level
* A high level of emotional intelligence coupled with a detailed & analytical approach to your work
* Hyper-organization and conscientiousness with outstanding execution skills
* A confident and concise communicator, both written and verbal, who enjoys getting to know people and leverages strong EQ to establish new relationships internally and with clients
* A strong initiative and “can do” attitude, with an ability to self-motivate, work independently and anticipate needs
* A knack for getting in the weeds and taking immense pride in attention to detail coupled with the ability to zoom out to keep one eye on the bigger picture

This role supports two Partners and their teams and is highly involved in client relationships while handling the logistics of consulting and coaching engagements, client offsites, and business development. Most of your time will be spent with a senior client-facing Partner and the project teams around her. The balance, roughly 25-40%, will be spent supporting Trium's Founder & Chairman, whose work centers on CEO coaching, relationship building, and business development. jobs.title: Deal and Contract Ops Manager, eero Business Operations
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are hiring a Deal and Contract Operations Manager to join our Business Operations team in San Francisco. In this role, you will design and own the end-to-end deal and contracting processes mainly by supporting and training deal owners on contracting workflows, including operational ownership of our contracting tool, acting as the escalation point before deals get stuck, coordinating across internal approver teams such as Legal, Tax, and Finance to keep deals moving forward, and ensuring every signed partner has a smooth onboarding experience by involving the right stakeholders pre- and post-close.  
  
Because you sit at the center of every deal, you will have a unique vantage point to spot what needs to be standardized, automated, or tooled across the deal lifecycle, and coordinate with the rest of the functions under Bizops (i.e. Sales Ops, Order Management, Business Systems etc.) to make it happen. You will use that perspective to build frameworks, drive process automation, and continuously reduce the time it takes to get from contract signing to customer onboarding, ensuring downstream teams like Partner Success, Order Management, and Logistics are engaged at the right time.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and maintain the end-to-end contract operations processes, from template selection support through approval alongside Legal so that deal owners (i.e. Business Development and Partner Success teams) can move deals through the process efficiently and with minimal friction.
* Project-manage deals from contract signing through customer onboarding, ensuring downstream teams (Partner Success, Order Management, RevOps, Logistics) are engaged at the right time prior to deal close, and that non-standard terms are highlighted and passed along to the correct stakeholders.
* Troubleshoot Contract Lifecycle Management (i.e.) workflow issues, advise on routing and approvals, and unblock bottlenecks so deal owners can keep momentum.
* Train and equip Business Development teams to be self-sufficient in the contracting process: how to create CLM workflows, select the right contract template and deal term configuration, route to the correct approvers, and anticipate approval requirements
* Ensure contract templates are properly created and maintained within the CLM system in adherence with the Amazon policy, and assist Business Development with escalating redlines to Legal and driving alignment on accepted terms.
* Use your centralized vantage point across all deals to spot patterns and identify what needs to be standardized, automated, or tooled, translating those insights into process improvements that make the entire deal lifecycle faster and more consistent.

You might start your morning checking in on active deals in Contract Central, spotting one that's waiting on Tax approval and flagging to the BD owner how long that step usually takes. By midday, you could be helping a Business Development lead pick the right contract template and approval routing for a non-standard deal, or bringing Partner Success and Order Management in ahead of a signing so onboarding starts smoothly. You will regularly train deal owners on contracting best practices and present recommendations to leaders on reducing time from signing to onboarding.  
  
About the team  
Our team keeps eero's partner deals and orders moving, from contract signing through delivery. As part of eero Business Operations, we work closely with Business Development, Partner Success, Legal, Finance, Order Management, and Logistics teams to build the processes and tools that help ISPs, Enterprise customers, and retail partners around the world get eero into their customers' homes and businesses. We value ownership, creative problem-solving, and using AI and automation to take manual work off our plates so we can focus on our partners. jobs.title: Strategic Operations Associate, Catering
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
This operations role sits within Uber for Business - one of Uber's fastest growing business units in terms of topline performance. Within this org, you'll join the founding team responsible for building and scaling Catering. Catering is an exciting strategic priority across both Uber for Business and the Delivery organization as a whole, changing the ways in which consumers and business customers use UberEats.  
  
Working alongside the U4B Head of Catering, you'll play a central role in making Catering expansion repeatable across markets. This will consist of operationalizing launch frameworks, coordinating market readiness across regional and global stakeholders, supporting market and account opportunity analysis, and identifying where local requirements require changes to the playbook. Sitting at the intersection of Strategy, Operations, Sales and regional Delivery teams, you'll help define how Catering scales from a small pilot product into a core part of Uber's business across the Globe.  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Market Launch Execution: Own the operational cadence for Catering launches across new markets, translating established launch frameworks into clear work plans, milestones, owners, and readiness criteria.
* Market Readiness: Coordinate cross-functional readiness across U4B, regional Delivery Strategy & Operations, Sales, Operations, and other local stakeholders to ensure each market is prepared to launch.
* Expansion Planning: Support market and account opportunity analysis, including book-building and lead identification, to help determine where and how Catering should expand.
* Playbook Iteration: Identify patterns and deviations across markets, distinguish local requirements from systemic gaps, and continuously improve the expansion playbook based on launch learnings.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Drive clear communication, issue resolution, and escalation across global and regional stakeholders while independently solving problems within the established framework.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience: At least 2 years of experience in program management, operations, strategy, launch operations, enablement operations, or a related field.
* Program Management: Strong organizational and execution skills, with experience managing multiple work streams, stakeholders, milestones, and dependencies at once.
* Structured Problem Solving: Ability to apply an established framework to new situations, identify meaningful deviations, and determine which issues can be solved directly versus escalated.
* Analytical Skills: Comfort working with business data to support market prioritization, performance monitoring, and operational decision-making.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across global, regional, and cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor's Degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Launch and Expansion Experience: Experience supporting multi-market launches, geographic expansion, or repeatable operational programs.
* Uber or Marketplace Knowledge: Familiarity with Uber, Delivery, U4B, or marketplace operating models is helpful but not required.
* Process Improvement: Demonstrated ability to identify recurring friction, improve operating processes, and make established programs more scalable over time.
* Technical & Analytical Skills: Comfortability with basic Uber-preferred AI tools including ChatGPT and Claude/Cortana.
* Adaptability: Comfort operating in a fast-moving, evolving environment, taking ownership of execution while maintaining strong judgment on when to escalate.

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $106,000 per year - USD $118,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $106,000 per year - USD $118,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. * Manage interfaces between facilities, technology, security, furniture, and construction vendors through regular meetings and project trackers.
* Coordinate the flow of project information through stakeholder meetings, written communications, and move readiness reviews.
* Forecast and update project milestones, schedules, budgets, occupancy plans, and resource requirements.
* Coordinate space planning and workplace changes in alignment with business needs and occupancy strategies.
* Oversee move planning, move execution, furniture deployment, and post-move support activities.
* Support change management initiatives and communicate workplace changes effectively to impacted stakeholders.
* Ensure all project activities are delivered with minimal disruption to ongoing business operations.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, Facilities Management, Business Administration, Interior Design, or a related field.
* Minimum **3 years of project management experience** supporting workplace, facilities, move management, space planning, or construction-related projects.
* Experience managing Move, Add, Change (MAC) programs, office relocations, workplace transformations, or occupancy projects.
* Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.
* Knowledge of workplace services, facilities operations, space planning, furniture systems, and move management processes.
* Effective presentation and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Procore, and workplace management/project management tools.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams including Facilities, IT, Security, Real Estate, and external vendors.
* Strong problem-solving, budgeting, scheduling, and project coordination capabilities.
* Excellent communication and client relationship management skills.

  
**Additional Information**

**\*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs\***

jobs.title: Commercial Roofing Project Manager/Roof Inspector
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced roofing professional to manage commercial roofing projects and document roof conditions at prospective client properties. You will give the Account Manager clear photos, field findings, and written reports to support proposals. Once work is approved, you will coordinate the project through completion. The Account Manager leads the sales process.

**Roof Observations and Reports**

· Visit prospective clients' commercial properties to observe existing roof conditions and discuss reported concerns.

· Take clear overview and detail photos; label them by building, roof area, and condition.

· Document visible roof issues, drainage concerns, relevant measurements, access needs, and existing roof materials.

· Prepare organized reports that explain observed conditions, identify recommended repairs or maintenance, and note areas needing further evaluation.

· Provide the Account Manager with reports, photos, and scope recommendations; answer technical questions during proposal preparation.

**Project Management**

· Manage approved roofing projects from planning and mobilization through final walkthrough and closeout.

· Monitor job progress, labor and material costs, workmanship, and compliance with the approved scope.

· Communicate with the Account Manager; address weather delays, site concerns, and scope changes through the company's approval process.

· Maintain progress photos and job records; coordinate punch list corrections and collect closeout documentation.

**Qualifications**

· 5 years commercial roofing experience and a working knowledge of common roof systems, repairs, maintenance, and installation practices.

· Experience working with roofing crews or projects; project manager, superintendent, foreman, estimator, or roof observer experience is valuable.

· Ability to recognize and accurately document roof conditions, take useful photos, and write clear reports.

· Strong organization, dependable follow-through, and professional communication with clients and coworkers.

· Comfort using email, mobile photo tools, and basic report or project management software.

· Valid driver's license and ability to travel between properties and safely access roofs using required safety equipment.

· Some out of State travel will be needed.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role means timely, useful roof reports; well-coordinated projects; early communication about problems; and completed work that meets the approved scope and quality expectations.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $105,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Commercial Roofing: 5 years (Required)

License/Certification:

* Driver License with clean MVR (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Santa Clara, CA 95054 (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager
jobs.description:
**What You'll Be Doing**
========================

**Job Scope:** Generally responsible for supervision and technical direction over a team of engineers and designers engaged in the total delivery of services on time, within performance budget and quality expectations. Work at this level requires extensive progressive experience in project management and involves the utilization of project controls for cost, schedule and quality of projects. This work will be performed under minimal supervision.

**Primary responsibilities will include but are not limited to:**

* Efficiently managing promotional projects minimizing the cost to Hargrove by working with the Engineering Resource Leaders to accurately estimate Professional Service man-hours to complete the project while achieving the objectives.
* Successfully managing commercial contract(s) on one or more projects of various sizes, as required. Ensuring that invoices are paid in a timely manner, Project Change Notices are processed, monthly Office Earnings Report (OER) is reviewed in the time allotted, and the project(s) plan in Vision is current.
* Maintaining control of the project by tracking and maintaining discipline performance budget progress, schedule commitments, and quality standards. Understanding and utilizing the project tools that are in place for project control.
* Validating professional service and construction estimates at the beginning of a project, and then tracking changes as the project progresses.
* Participating in development of all major technical, cost, scheduling and performance decisions.
* Familiarity with project scope, specifications, deliverables required by client, and design criteria upon assignment to a project and gaining Hargrove team alignment of schedule and budget in regard to deliverables required. Work with client team to define project scope, goals and deliverables that support business goals in collaboration with stakeholders.
* Recognizing and communicating scope and design changes promptly by championing the Project Change Notice process and promoting a positive Change Management culture.
* Leading the effort in building a productive Team both within Hargrove and with the client. Utilize rewards where applicable to recognize outstanding contributions.
* Coordinating resource requirements with other ongoing project work and insure all parties’ expectations are aligned.
* Planning and organizing the work of the team. Communicating the plan to your team, the project leadership team and the client. Aligning the expectations of all parties. Conduct weekly coordination meetings with the Team.
* Maintaining timely and accurate reporting including weekly and monthly reports utilizing a comprehensive action item list. Reviewing engineering documents, vendor submittals, fabrication drawings and other construction submittals for compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, good engineering practice, and project objectives. Project Manager is responsible for ensuring all documentation is reviewed and checked against vendor submittals, specifications, interdiscipline, etc. regardless of resource location. Ensuring that standard project work processes are followed by all team members through all phases of engineering, procurement, and construction.
* Interviewing discipline leads to maintain up-to-date progress against man hour expended analysis recognizing the Project Manager is responsible for overall financial health of each project with the respective discipline leads being responsible for producing the required deliverables within the given budget.
* Assessing the performance of the project team members through the course of the project, and work with resource leadership to organize a qualified and motivated project team.
* Ensuring project documentation is properly reviewed and approved by the client.
* Providing Construction Phase Support, start-up assistance, and response to Requests for Information, as needed.
* Managing timeliness of client team decision making and package approval.
* Promoting continuing positive relations with the client building on long term relationships that continue to add additional services.
* Completing project closeout as required by the client and Hargrove work procedures. Participating in the planning of training programs, continuous education opportunities and professional development of staff.
* Effectively and proactively manage the client at all stages of the project.

Below is the range that we in good faith believe is the potential compensation for this role at the time of this posting and is only applicable for jobs to be performed in California. The typical base salary range for this position is just one component of Hargrove’s total compensation package for Teammates. Actual compensation will be based on education, experience, skill set and location.

Minimum Salary: $210,000 annually

Maximum Salary: $250,000 annually

**Ideal Background**
====================

**Education:** Bachelor or Master of Science degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or Civil Engineering from an accredited university is preferred.

**Certification:** Professional Engineering and/or Project Management Professional (PMP) registration is highly preferred.

**Experience:** This position requires 15+ years of relevant experience in engineering and project management.

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Knowledge of the Hargrove project execution procedures.
* Knowledge and application of company business standards and good practices.
* Knowledge and application of company engineering standards and project controls tools.
* Demonstrated proficiency in complex project management.
* Ability to lead a team to deliver on commitments.
* A comprehensive understanding of the function of all engineering disciplines, procurement, and construction processes.
* Ability to manage client relationships in complex situations.
* Ability to relate easily to others in the busine

jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end-to-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day-to-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology-focused project management
* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end-to-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

**Immediate Employment**

  

* + Compensation from $130,000.00 - $150,000.00
  + Company Vehicle
  + Fuel Card & Fastrak

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a Fire Systems Project Manager with experience in **fire alarm installation, life safety, and low voltage construction**. Our Project Managers (PM) are responsible for the execution of low voltage system projects in accordance with project budgets, code compliance, and managing the field operations team’s work quality and work output. This position will work closely with our sales team, installation team, and clients to ensure a sound design, seamless installation, and professional commissioning of our projects. The PM is a key position for our growing team and requires attention to detail in all aspects of planning and executing projects. Customer interface and management of staff require a high degree of effective human relations. Communication skills, both verbal and written, are important aspects of the PM position.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Planning & Execution**

  

* + Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables.
  + Develop and manage project budgets, schedules, and work plans.
  + Assign tasks and manage resources to meet project goals.
  + Coordinate with internal departments, subcontractors, and vendors.
  + Ensure compliance with project specifications, codes, and safety standards.
  + Maintain accurate project documentation (RFIs, submittals, change orders, equipment logs, meeting minutes).

* + Develop construction schedules and manpower plans.
  + Conduct pre-construction, progress, and close-out meetings.
  + Interface with inspectors and ensure all permits and fees are obtained.

* + Prepare and manage budgets, cost forecasts, and billing schedules.
  + Review, estimate, and process change orders.
  + Support positive cash flow and assist with project close-out analysis.

**Customer & Team Communication**

  

* + Serve as the primary customer contact for all project phases.
  + Collaborate with Sales, Engineering, Service, and Field Operations teams.
  + Identify and resolve project issues or conflicts efficiently.

**Major Responsibilities Breakdown**

  

* + Customer Coordination – 30%
  + RFI, Change Order, and Material Log – 20%
  + Construction Schedule Management – 20%
  + Monthly Billing Schedule – 10%
  + Interdepartmental Coordination – 10%

  + Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills.
  + Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
  + Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

* + Sitting – Constantly (6-8 hours/daily)

  + Standing- Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)
  + Standing on Ladder- Occasionally (0-3 hours/daily)

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager reports to the Director, Capital Program Delivery Infrastructure, and is responsible for developing, managing, and delivering of rail capital projects from capital planning, design, construction, and close out phases for the Peninsula Corridor Joint Powers Board (Caltrain). Essential Functions & Duties:

* Develop and manage the scope, schedule, and budget of Caltrain capital projects ensuring alignment with organizational goals and project objectives.
* Provide full life-cycle leadership from project execution planning, design, procurement, construction, systems integration, commissioning, and final closeout.
* Develop and maintain the project execution plan or/and project management plan PMP and support execution strategies to effective governance, risk mitigation, quality control and successful project delivery.
* Manage and coordinate all resources necessary to deliver assigned projects, including cross function departments within Rail and external consultants, Resident Engineer, Construction Management Staff, contractors, third parties and regulatory agencies throughout the project
* Ensure Safety First and Always Core Value is implemented through life cycle of project delivery.
* Work closely with the assigned project engineer(s) to ensure that all deliverables are compliant with Caltrain standards.
* Acts as the Point of Contact with internal and external stakeholders for assigned projects. Manage coordination and communications with all involved parties, including other agencies, third parties and tenant railroads
* Provide board and executive level reporting on project status, performance metrics and critical risks.
* Manage the Designer of Record and Construction Contractor to ensure delivery of the assigned projects.
* Oversee Project contract administration, change management and claim avoidance to protect Caltrain’s interest.
* Investigate, negotiate, and resolve project issues. Identify the root cause of problems and present appropriate solutions. Escalate issues to the Delivery Directors accordingly to ensure timely resolutions.

---------------------------------------

**Natera** | Entry-Level | Lab Operations

### **About Natera**

Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, with diagnostic solutions spanning Women's Health, Oncology, Organ Health, and Rare Disease. Our work helps clinicians and patients make earlier, better-informed health decisions, and our teams are driven by the impact of that mission every day.

### **About the Role**

As a Project Coordinator on our Lab Operations team, you'll be the organizational backbone that keeps cross-functional projects moving. You'll support Program and Project Managers across a variety of department initiatives, handling the scheduling, documentation, and tracking that help teams deliver on time and within scope. This is an excellent entry point for someone early in their career who wants hands-on exposure to project management in a fast-paced, science-driven environment.

### **What You'll Do**

* Prepare and distribute meeting agendas, capture meeting minutes, and maintain action item and decision logs
* Track project deliverables and follow up on document approvals, including design control documentation, under the direction of the Program Manager
* Maintain and update project schedules and Gantt charts to keep status and timelines accurate
* Schedule and coordinate project team meetings and manage logistics so issues are resolved quickly
* Adapt to shifting priorities and support multiple projects or programs as needed
* Perform other duties as assigned

### **What You'll Bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in a scientific, engineering, or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* 0–2 years of experience in a project support, administrative, or coordination role (internships and co-ops count)
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills, and comfort working with cross-functional teams and leadership
* Proven ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar productivity tools, and a willingness to learn new systems quickly
* A proactive, dependable, team-oriented approach

**Nice to Have**

* Coursework or exposure to life sciences, molecular biology, or genetics

This is primarily an office-based role. You'll use a computer keyboard, communicate by phone and video, and read printed and digital material. Occasional work outside normal business hours, including evenings and weekends, may be required.

**OUR OPPORTUNITY**

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. jobs.title: People Service Delivery Lead
jobs.description:
The People Service Delivery (PSD) team's mission is to run a high-performing, people-focused service delivery organization. Leading with care and empathy, we develop efficient processes, systems, and programs. We aim to ensure employees feel heard and have the resources and support they need during the most important moments so that they can do their best work of their careers.The People Service Delivery Lead sits at the intersection of people operations domain expertise and hands-on engineering. This role owns large-scale transformation programs end to end and, unlike a traditional program role, also contributes to designing and building the solutions those programs depend on. This lead reads HR, payroll, and people-operations workflows fluently, identifies where the seams and inefficiencies are, and then helps architect tooling solutions that close them.Working closely with leaders across People Operations, executive sponsors, engineering, and other key XFN stakeholders, this lead challenges assumptions and the status quo to improve processes, reduce barriers, and mitigate risks. Much of the work is greenfield: problems arrive without a playbook, and this lead builds the path as they walk it. This person does not need to have the “correct” answer to everything. What matters is the ability to quickly drive the conversation toward a productive solution by bringing together the right people, process, and technology, including building a working prototype when that is the fastest way to create clarity.A key expectation of this role is to be an active driver of AI adoption and creative problem-solving in operations. This lead looks for opportunities to responsibly use AI and automation to reduce manual work, improve consistency, accelerate resolution times, and enhance the employee experience while ensuring strong governance, quality, and appropriate handling of sensitive information.  
  
  

### **People Service Delivery Lead Responsibilities:**

* Deconstruct end-to-end employee lifecycle journeys (from hire through movement, leave, and exit) to identify seams, handoff failure points, and automation opportunities across teams and systems, then build the solutions that address them
* Drive AI-enabled operational improvements, including identifying use cases for automation, workflow optimization, knowledge management, and case deflection, balancing efficiency with employee care and quality outcomes
* Improve efficiency and quality of systems and operations through end-to-end process frameworks and optimization initiatives, and design the change management that drives adoption of new processes, systems, or tooling, including training and communication plans for all levels, locations, and XFN partners
* Partner with HR Tech, engineering teams, and vendors to identify, build, and implement appropriate technology solutions
* oversee system integration efforts and ensure a smooth transition and adoption
* Identify, escalate, and mitigate program risk proactively rather than reactively

* Experience operating independently through ambiguity, navigating competing and shifting priorities to maintain momentum, and delivering results in a detail-oriented, highly organized manner

The candidate will represent the firm in all interactions with clients, contractors, and other project team members. In this role, you will oversee the complete design project team in the design of the building, including in-house mechanical, electrical plumbing, and technology systems, as well as sub-consultant team members such as architects, structural and civil engineers.

  

This is a senior-level position that requires a self-motivated individual with strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills. The successful candidate will be highly analytical, possess exceptional problem-solving skills, can multi-task, work independently, and as a productive and engaged team member in a fast-paced environment.

* Strong interpersonal and customer service skills and demonstrated ability to communicate with internal and external business partners.
* Solid knowledge of codes, standards, and construction/engineering processes.

Our Care Coordination & Office Operations Team is at the heart of that work. We coordinate referrals, schedules, communication, documentation, credentialing, and billing support while helping clients, nurses, and healthcare partners feel informed and well supported.

**About the Position**

This is a hands-on role within a collaborative, growing small business. Priorities can shift throughout the day as new referrals arrive, schedules change, or a client or nurse needs timely assistance. The right person enjoys bringing calm and organization to a responsive environment, takes genuine ownership of their work, and follows important details through to completion.

Every team member is cross-trained in TLC's core operations so we can support one another, provide dependable coverage, and continue improving how we work.

**What You Will Do**

· Coordinate new and ongoing nursing referrals, schedules, and coverage needs.

· Communicate professionally and compassionately with clients, families, independent nurses, specialty pharmacies, physicians, healthcare facilities, case managers, discharge planners, and other referral partners.

· Respond to phone calls, emails, text messages, and faxes in a timely and organized manner.

· Manage schedule changes, cancellations, urgent coverage requests, and other time-sensitive needs.

· Review nursing documentation for completeness and process it promptly.

· Assist with client invoicing, contractor invoice processing, and related follow-up.

· Maintain accurate scheduling, credentialing, compliance, and operational records.

· Follow written Standard Operating Procedures while helping identify practical workflow improvements.

· Support teammates and participate in shared evening, weekend, and holiday on-call coverage.

**Who Thrives Here**

People who thrive at TLC care about doing things well, helping others, and contributing to the organization as a whole. They tend to:

· Take ownership, show initiative, and follow responsibilities through to completion.

· Stay organized, responsive, and attentive to details while managing multiple priorities.

· Enjoy figuring things out, connecting the pieces, and learning how different parts of the work fit together.

· Communicate clearly, warmly, kindly, and proactively with clients, nurses, healthcare partners, and teammates.

· Remain calm, thoughtful, and solution-focused when circumstances change or something unexpected comes up.

· Use sound judgment, make confident routine decisions, and ask thoughtful questions when collaboration is helpful.

· Notice what needs attention and help move it forward rather than waiting for every next step to be assigned.

· Take pride in becoming knowledgeable, capable, and dependable in their work.

· Bring a positive, helpful attitude and genuinely enjoy contributing to a collaborative team.

· Value teamwork, flexibility, accountability, continuous learning, and exceptional client service.

**Qualifications**

· **Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) preferred.**

· Strong organizational, written communication, and verbal communication skills.

· Comfort managing multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.

· Ability to work independently and contribute to a close, collaborative team.

· Comfort learning scheduling, credentialing, documentation, communication, and office systems.

· Healthcare administration, care coordination, scheduling, office operations, or customer service experience is helpful.

· Full-time position starting at $33-$35 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.

· Flexible scheduling with a thoughtful combination of office and remote work when appropriate.

The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life.
