jobs.description:
**About Overwatch Mission Critical**

Overwatch is a service-disabled Veteran-owned small business (SDVOB) certified through the National Veterans Business Development Council (NVBDC), offering construction professional services, talent acquisition, and general contractor services for the mission-critical infrastructure industry.

Our mission is the construction and management of state-of-the-art data centers with the precision and reliability this industry demands. From high-end engineers to seasoned professionals, we deploy the people you need to get your data center off the ground. At Overwatch, it's more than a job — it's purpose.

**Overview**

**Scope of Work**

**1. Quality Program Oversight & Auditing**

* Audit the GC’s QA/QC Plan: Review and approve the contractor’s Quality Management Plan. Ensure they have the staff and processes to manage a hyperscale-level scope.
* Surveillance & Spot Checks: Perform independent field walks and "pothole" inspections to verify that the GC’s reporting matches the physical reality on-site.
* BIM & VDC Alignment: Ensure that field installations match the coordinated 3D models and that "clash-free" designs are maintained during high-density MEP installs.

**2. Technical System Validation (Civil, Structural, MEP)**

* **Electrical Infrastructure:** Oversee the quality of Medium Voltage (MV) and Low Voltage (LV) systems, UPS plants, and backup generators.
* **Mechanical/Cooling:** Validate the integrity of chilled water loops, CRAH/CRAC units, and massive air-handling systems.
* **Envelope & Shell:** Ensure the "white space" is airtight and meets specific humidity and particulate requirements.

**3. Issue Management & Resolution**

* **Non-Conformance Reports (NCR):** Review all NCRs issued by the GC. For major issues, lead the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to ensure the defect doesn't repeat across the campus.
* **Punch List Management:** Drive the "Zero-Punch" philosophy, ensuring issues are caught during installation rather than at the end of the project.

**4. Commissioning (Cx) Liaison**

* **Level 1 through Level 5 Testing:** Act as the bridge between construction and the Commissioning Agent (CxA). Verify that Level 1 (Factory Acceptance) and Level 2 (Site Acceptance) testing is documented correctly before moving to integrated systems testing (IST).
* **Document Control:** Ensure all Operations & Maintenance (O&M) manuals, warranties, and as-builts are pristine and ready for the Owner's Operations team.

* Quality Assurance & Quality Control

**Communication Skills**

Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively in a professional work environment, including preparing written reports and documentation, conveying information clearly to team members, clients, and stakeholders, and responding appropriately to verbal and written communications related to job duties.

**Physical Requirements and Work Environment**

This position operates primarily in an active data center construction environment, encompassing both indoor and outdoor work settings. The role requires the physical ability to perform essential job functions safely and effectively in a dynamic environment that includes ongoing construction activity and evolving site conditions.

The work environment includes areas and temporary structures owned, leased, or controlled by third parties over which Overwatch may have limited or no control. Because the project remains under construction, certain areas of the site — including access routes, staging zones, and temporary structures — may not yet be fully ADA-compliant until construction is complete or those third-party areas are finalized.

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to walk, stand, stoop, twist, bend, and climb stairs or ladders for extended periods while navigating uneven, unpaved, or obstructed terrain.
* Must be able to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds on an occasional basis.
* Must be able to drive between job sites and access all areas of an active construction zone, including raised platforms, scaffolding, and confined spaces.
* Must be able to tolerate exposure to outdoor weather conditions, dust, and construction-related noise, vibrations, and odors.
* Must be able to communicate effectively with contractors, engineers, and site personnel, and maintain situational awareness in high-activity environments.
* Personal protective equipment (PPE), including hard hats, safety vests, hearing protection, and steel-toe boots, is required.

jobs.description:
Description:

The Street Health Outreach program is an innovative project which identifies and assists people in the Central Alameda County who are experiencing homelessness and have chronic health and mental health needs. The Street Health Outreach Team supports clients to attain housing stability and improve health and well-being.

Using a multi-disciplined team approach, the program provides street and venue-based outreach and engagement, assessment, health services and triage, case management, linkages to housing agencies and mental health services. The program will work with all participants to develop and carry out action plans that improve health and wellness.

Under the supervision of the Street Health Outreach Program Director, the **Street Health Outreach Behavioral Health Case Manager I** will work directly with participants in conducting evidence-based behavioral health assessments, health coaching, and supporting clients with navigating mental health and substance use treatment systems from a harm reduction and trauma-informed approach.

**Schedule:** This is a full-time position, working 40 hours per week, typically Monday through Friday, with occasional Saturday hours.

**About TVHC:** Tiburcio Vasquez Health Center is a nonprofit community health center dedicated to promoting the health and well-being of our community by providing accessible, high-quality care through the integration of primary care, dental care, WIC support, mental health counseling, community health education, and more.

**Benefits:** We offer excellent benefits, including: medical (100% paid co-payments, premiums, etc.), dental, vision (including dependent and domestic partner coverage), generous paid leave benefits including holidays, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement plans with an Employer match, tuition reimbursement, monthly treats, pet insurance, and more.

**Compensation:** $32.19 - $35.17 per hour, depending on experience.

*This position is represented by SEIU, with compensation and benefits determined by the terms of the Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA). Salary is based on the wage scales outlined in the agreement. Beyond base pay, TVHC provides a comprehensive compensation package that supports the health, wealth, and career development of our employees.*

### **Responsibilities:**

* Conduct behavioral health assessments, provide health coaching, triage clients, triage and support clients with navigating mental health and substance use treatment systems.
* Maintain a caseload of clients who are identified to need more in-depth case management services.
* Provide outreach and engagement, health services and triage, and collaboration with Housing Resource Centers.
* Build relationships over time via consistent visits with patients and potential patients.
* Screen and identify individuals with medical and behavioral needs.
* Prioritize individuals with high medical and behavioral health needs and/or Substance Use Disorders for intensive visits to improve health and lift them out of homelessness.
* Participate in regular meetings with Alameda County Healthcare for the Homeless.
* Provide culturally competent, trauma informed, and harm reduction-based services.
* Conduct regular outreach and engagement, building trust with individuals encountered at encampments and other service locations according to the responsive schedule.
* Respond to immediate survival needs as prioritized by clients, e.g. basic needs, problem-solving, health education and information about health and community services.
* Provide assessments and administer appropriate screening tools (e.g. PHQ2 and PHQ9) and SBIRT services.
* Provide crisis assistance and brief behavioral health interventions (Motivational Interviewing, Problem Solving Therapy, psychological/emotional support around obtaining housing).
* Conduct brief, non-stigmatizing screenings to evaluate the needs of homeless individuals for mental health and support services.
* Document assessments and care provided in patient’s EPIC chart.
* Provide linkage and referrals to community services as needed and work from an interdisciplinary approach.
* Participate with other staff in multidisciplinary staff meetings and other staff processes to achieve program development, staff development, program evaluation, program operations review, and other activities as appropriate.
* Maintain confidentiality regarding privileged administrative and patient information and complete required documentation in a timely manner.
* Completes Coordinated Entry Assessments for individuals seeking housing.

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and expectations required of the position.*

Requirements:

* High school diploma (or G.E.D.) required.
* Valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification must be obtained prior to start date.
* Minimum of one (1) year of field experience working with people with serious mental illness, individuals with a dual diagnosis and/or the homeless population required.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred.

**Qualifications:**

* Experience working with unhoused or housing unstable patients.
* Have a working knowledge and ability to implement harm reduction and motivational interviewing.
* Must be able to identify potential escalating situations and safety risks. Must be knowledgeable and ability to deescalate.
* Have a thorough knowledge of the principles and practices of medicine and allied services commensurate with his/her training.
* Demonstrated ability to build the trust and respect of patients, staff, colleagues, external contacts, and other organizational members.
* Good problem-solving skills required, including creativity, resourcefulness, timeliness, and technical knowledge related to analyzing and resolving medical problems.
* Willingness and ability to work some evenings and week

jobs.description:
**Who we are:** La Clínica de La Raza is a community-based health center committed to providing culturally appropriate, high-quality, and accessible health care to the diverse communities of the San Francisco Bay Area. We have spent over 40 years advocating for and creating a health home for the many that have been denied access to care. As health care activists, we are dedicated to making sure individuals who do not have health coverage get the same level of quality healthcare as those who have it. From our genesis as a community health center in 1971, we understood that we cannot heal our communities without also addressing the economic and social factors that affect health. Many times, this requires that we go outside and provide services in other settings to build the bridge that links individuals to our health center for preventive and primary care. Over 90,000 individuals come to La Clínica because it is a welcoming place that addresses the whole person, coordinating and connecting them to a broad network of services to improve and maintain their health and wellbeing. While we are still known for our activism and spirit of social justice, we are also proud to have grown into a sophisticated provider of primary health care services with 35 sites across Alameda, Contra Costa and Solano counties.

Many people excel at one of these areas, but it takes someone with a special combination of skills and character to do both. To be successful, you need to enjoy interacting with all kinds of different people, to feel energized by a fast-paced clinic environment and remain cool under pressure even when serving a person who is upset, disrespectful or impatient. You should have a successful history of being responsible, reliable and capable of solving problems while being friendly and helpful in looking for ways to support other care team members.

**Major Areas of Responsibility include but are not limited to:**

Patient Care

* Participate in health coaching including activities such as: medication adherence, counseling patients on healthy behaviors, providing patients with support on self-management goals, and referrals to access a range of healthcare services.
* Update and maintain registry of patients, using robust tracking system, that can follow patients based on panels belonging to individual primary providers OR disease /condition such as HIV, Hypertension, Diabetes, Coronary Artery disease, etc.
* Assist in training and support Medical Assistants in panel management.

Commitment to Quality

* Systematically review registries for target populations/panels, to conduct predetermined interventions agreed upon by health care team and performing coach visits with patients including strict adherence guidelines and documentation.
* Contribute to quality improvement efforts by providing feedback and progress reports to Site Improvement Teams on health status and outcomes of panels.
* Collaborate with other health care team members, such as health educators or BMS, to support individual or group-based interventions of care.

General Office Duties

Activities may range from messenger functions such as ordering labs, or performing INRs, A1C testing, scheduling appointments, coordinating referrals, or may include more complex health coaching visit responsibilities and may use standing orders to address common problems.
* Attend section meetings and other meetings that supports the job responsibilities.

Knowledge

* Knowledge of chronic care model, fundamentals of health education, motivational interviewing and supporting patients with self-assessment goals desired
* Proficient managing patient databases and other computer software programs such as Excel, Outlook, and practice management systems

Abilities

* Self-driven individual with ability to work independently and exercise good judgment. Also, able to work effectively with teams, demonstrating willingness to collaborate to improve services, care management and data processes.
* Ability to protect and maintain strict confidentiality and accurate and detail patient medical information.
* Ability to work across cultures and demonstrate support of diversity, equity and inclusion.
* Ability to work courteously and effectively as a team member to support the quality/efficiency standards established for the clinic.

Experience

* Requires a valid license to practice as a Vocational Nurse in the State of California.
* One to two years' experience in an outpatient facility working with adults and children.
* Must hold a current BLS (Basic Life Support) Certificate. You will have 30-day grace period to obtain your certificate from the date of hire.
* Experience working with patients in the capacity of health promotion, with knowledge of medical terminology, chronic health conditions, and health coaching.
* Bilingual English/Spanish required

You will focus on the strategy, planning, and operational systems of Executive Development and its learning experiences, ensuring the work we do addresses real needs, is targeted, and makes a real difference to our leaders and the business.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, Executive Development Responsibilities:**

* Own the portfolio and prioritization system. Design and run the system and recurring reviews that keep all Executive Development work visible, scoped, and prioritized — including which design ideas are queued, committed, or parked, so the agenda is deliberate rather than reactive.
* Serve as strategic thought partner to the VP, Executive Development. Bring evidence, options, and a recommendation, and guide annual and quarterly planning.
* Protect team and senior leader capacity. Sequence high-value design and delivery work, make overcommitment visible before it affects delivery, flag when timelines are at risk of collapsing, and escalate with ranked options rather than problems.
* Own everything that happens before a cohort starts: curation and selection, the invitation list and cohort timing, the design cycle and its decision gates, and the faculty partnership — setting the experience standard the program is held to.
* Develop the faculty, coach, and vendor bench. Build bench depth, define how facilitators are matched to programs, and run the quality evaluation that informs future assignments.
* Partner with the VP and design partners on the design and modernization of learning experiences. Bring delivery, participant, and measurement evidence, pressure-test feasibility, and translate design intent into work the team can build and run.
* Build new offerings end to end — the build plan, coordination with designers, decision gates, and the launch and communications strategy for an executive audience, including leading socialization with senior stakeholders directly.
* Build and ship AI-enabled learning experiences that modernize how senior leaders learn, reflect, and are coached — judging what should be AI-enabled versus left human, and holding the bar on participant experience and privacy.
* Own measurement and the insight narrative. Define what we measure and why, synthesize themes across programs, and answer "is this working?" with evidence that shapes investment and retirement decisions.
* Build relationships and influence cross-functional partners early. Work with recruiting and HR partners while new initiatives are still being shaped, securing early line of sight into changes that affect the portfolio.
* Jump in and manage evolving priorities, including planning and executing special projects as needed.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years experience developing and executing business and/or learning solutions
* Entrepreneurial multi-tasker who can be highly efficient with ambiguity and complexity
* Demonstrated track record of leading strategy and planning work in complex environments
* Demonstrated track record of owning a portfolio or system of programs — not only individual programs — including prioritization and capacity trade-off decisions
* Demonstrated track record of thinking strategically and acting operationally while managing ambiguity, risk, and changing direction
* Demonstrated track record of developing and delivering communications for an executive audience, including change management and go-to-market plans
* Demonstrated track record of background in working directly with VP-level or equivalent senior leaders
* Experience as a strategic thought partner to senior executives, with demonstrated influence on what an organization chooses to work on
* Experience defining measurement strategy and translating data into recommendations
* Experience building and launching new programs or offerings, including the socialization required to land them with senior stakeholders
* Experience applying AI tools to design or improve how work gets done

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience in executive development, leadership development, or executive coaching
* Experience building AI-enabled learning or coaching experiences
* Bachelor's Degree

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Contracts are the oldest business technology in human history. They allow us to collaborate: they define what we promise each other, how we work together, and what happens when things go wrong.

You'll balance a higher volume of accounts than our enterprise team, relying on efficient, repeatable processes to drive onboarding, adoption, and renewals across a broad book of business.

* **Usage and Adoption:** Drive adoption through scalable engagement tactics (in-app guidance, email campaigns, office hours) rather than bespoke, high-touch engagement.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 3-7 years of experience in a SaaS customer success or account management role, ideally managing a high-volume portfolio of mid-market accounts; experience in legal tech or with legal professionals is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Associate Member Services Analyst
jobs.description:
For over a century, the **Workers' Compensation Insurance Rating Bureau of California (WCIRB)** has been California's trusted, objective provider of actuarially based information and research, advisory pure premium rates and educational services integral to a healthy workers' compensation system. The WCIRB is a California unincorporated, private, nonprofit association comprised of all companies licensed to transact workers' compensation insurance in California. The operations of the WCIRB are funded primarily by membership fees and assessments; no state money is used to fund its operations. The WCIRB is a stable company and a proven leader in the workers’ compensation insurance industry nationwide.

The WCIRB performs a number of functions to accurately measure the cost of providing workers' compensation benefits and ensure a healthy workers’ compensation system. To learn more about our company, please visit About Us | WCIRB California. The WCIRB employs approximately 175 people with an average tenure of over 10 years. We are committed to fostering a healthy, safe and diverse work environment leading to a dedicated, collaborative and innovative workforce. This is a **hybrid position** where approximately 40% of the work time is spent at the home office in San Francisco, California.

**Job Summary**

The **Member Services Associate Analyst** is responsible for ensuring the accuracy of workers’ compensation policy and loss data, and for the accurate calculation and timely publication of experience modifications for eligible employers in California. The Associate Analyst assists insurers in complying with the California Insurance Commissioner’s regulations outlined in the California Workers’ Compensation Uniform Statistical Reporting Plan—1995 and the California Workers’ Compensation Experience Rating Plan—1995, as they pertain to data reporting, experience rating and ownership. This is an entry level position for new staff and does not require any prior knowledge of insurance or workers’ compensation regulations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Completion of a training program, with coaching and mentorship provided by team members
* Reviews policy and unit statistical report (USR) data for accuracy to ensure WCIRB core responsibilities and services are not negatively impacted, including experience rating, advisory pure premium rates and coverage information.
* Follows department procedures for reviewing and processing policy and USR audit errors; timely review and resolution of insurer responses to audit errors in accordance with department standards.
* Provides verbal and written coaching and guidance to data reporters to resolve systemic data reporting issues and improve data quality.
* Collaborates frequently with team members, leadership, and other internal stakeholders to identify and resolve customer data reporting issues.
* Performs analytical research to determine proper ownership and combinability of entities; taking the requisite steps to ensure experience modifications are applied correctly to all impacted policies following ownership decision.
* Reviews policy information to identify potential lapses or overlapping insurance coverage and initiates communication with insurers to resolve.
* Identifies and timely reports system issues; collaborates with internal stakeholders to document and implement fixes for resolution.
* Participates in special projects or tasks, as assigned by management.

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma required; Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience preferred
* Excellent analytical, communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent time manager with ability to meet deadlines and meet department performance requirements.
* Exhibits customer-centric mentality, focusing on adding value to our member insurers and other customers, providing clear explanations regarding complex issues and answering questions in a professional manner.
* Must be able to multi-task and pay close attention to the details.
* Experience in a customer-facing role

**Perks & Benefits**  
Our employees enjoy a state of the art, energy-efficient, open work environment that nurtures collaboration and creativity. At the WCIRB, we go the extra mile to keep our employees happy and healthy.

Proud to be recognized as a Plan Sponsor of the Year finalist for our commitment to retirement readiness through strong 401k and pension offerings.

**Some of our perks include:**

* **Hybrid work environment (40% onsite 60% remote)**
* Medical, dental and vision benefits
* Competitive PTO Program
* Wellness benefits
* 401K and pension plan
* Social activities
* Community volunteer involvement

WCIRB is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

The successful candidate will reside in California and will work from our headquarters in San Francisco at least 40% of the time. We are NOT able to pay for relocation costs for candidates or to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

**Thank you for your interest in the WCIRB!**

  + Cash and bank management
  + Fixed assets

**Project Manager**

Program Management | Full-Time, Salaried | Reports to the Co-CEOs

**Company** Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

**Location** Remote, anywhere in the USA.

**Compensation** $75,000 to $105,000 base.

**Travel** Occasional travel to Las Vegas for quarterly planning and major project kickoffs.

**About the Role**

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas.

We are hiring a Project Manager to join our Program Management team, reporting directly to the Co-CEOs. You will work side by side with our Director of Program Management, the senior member of the team, and take full ownership of a slate of live projects across engineering, product, AI, and marketing.

Your job is delivery. You take each project from intake to closeout: scope, plan, schedule, risks, dependencies, status, and the retrospective at the end. On any project you own, leadership always knows where it stands and the team always knows what happens next.

Technical work runs in Jira. Marketing work runs in Monday. Documentation lives in Confluence. You work fluently across all three.

**Who Should Apply**

We are especially open to candidates from these backgrounds:

* Project Managers at software, digital, or product companies who have run several concurrent projects and can show the numbers they moved
* Technical Project Managers who have delivered engineering work and are comfortable coordinating with marketing
* Agency or professional services Project Managers who have owned SOWs, scope changes, and client reporting and want to go in-house
* Marketing or Growth Operations professionals who have grown into full-lifecycle project ownership

Titles vary. A track record of shipping on time is the bar.

**What You'll Find on Day One**

* Operations and technical teams actively running their work in Jira, with sprints, boards, and owners in place
* A backlog of legacy epics from projects abandoned as far back as seven years ago, ready to be reviewed and cleaned up
* Marketing projects running in Monday, with hand-offs to engineering that need a clear owner
* A draft intake and governance framework that needs to be tested on real projects
* A Director of Program Management as your senior teammate, and Co-CEOs who read project status every week
* Permission to fix what you find. If a workflow is slowing delivery, you change it.

**What You'll Own**

**Project Delivery, End to End**

* Own a slate of concurrent projects from intake through closeout. Write the project charter for each: objective, success metric, sponsor, scope, milestones, and budget where one applies.
* Break scope into a work breakdown, a realistic schedule, and a critical path. Keep baselines honest as the work evolves.
* Choose the delivery approach that fits the work: predictive, Agile, or hybrid.
* Run kickoffs, working sessions, and project standups for the projects you own. Facilitate sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives where a team needs them.
* Close every project with a retrospective and a lessons-learned entry in Confluence.

**Scope, Change, and Risk Control**

* Guard scope. Every change request gets a written impact on timeline, cost, and resources, and a named decision-maker.
* Maintain a RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) for every project. Surface each risk early with a proposed mitigation.
* Map dependencies between engineering and marketing and resolve them before they become blockers.
* Manage vendor and contractor deliverables against their statements of work.

**Status, Reporting, and Stakeholder Communication**

* Publish a weekly status for each project: health, progress against milestones, risks, and decisions needed. Short, specific, and read once.
* Feed accurate project-level data into the portfolio view the Director of Program Management presents to the Co-CEOs.
* Tailor communication to the audience. An engineer, a marketer, and a Co-CEO each get the level of detail they need.
* Escalate early when a project is at risk. Bring the problem, the options, and your recommendation.

**Tool Hygiene and Process Improvement**

* Keep every project you own clean in Jira and Monday: named owners, due dates, current status, and a definition of done.
* Lead the cleanup of legacy epics from abandoned projects. Confirm status with the original teams, archive or close what is finished or dead, and re-plan anything that still matters.
* Apply the draft intake and governance framework on live projects and report back on what works and what needs to change.
* Build templates, checklists, and runbooks so each new project starts faster than the last.

**Supporting the OKR Cadence**

* Link each of your projects to the Key Result it serves, so every project has a clear line to a company objective.
* Support the Director of Program Management in running quarterly OKR planning and weekly check-ins in Monday: prepare the data, collect updates, and track follow-ups to closure.

**Required Qualifications**

* Three or more years of hands-on project management experience delivering software, digital, or marketing projects, with several projects running at once.
* A delivery record you can quantify. On-time rates, cycle times, defect rates, or budget performance you improved, and by how much.
* Command of core project management practice: charters, schedules, critical path, RAID logs, change control, and stakeholder management.
* Comfortable running Agile, predictive, and hybrid delivery, and choosing the right approach for the work.

Arango delivers a unified, natively multimodel contextual data platform that powers AI agents, assistants, and applications with the unified, current, and trusted business context needed to reason, decide, and act at scale.

The Arango Contextual Data Platform connects fragmented enterprise data with LLMs, copilots, and AI agents through a simplified architecture delivered out of the box. By combining graph, vector, document, key-value, and search capabilities in a single platform, Arango eliminates the complex stacks many organizations build to operationalize enterprise AI.

Trusted by organizations including NVIDIA, HPE, the London Stock Exchange, PSI CRO, the U.S. Air Force, NIH, Siemens, Transient.AI, Matpriskollen, and Articul8, Arango helps enterprises move from AI pilots to reliable production systems faster while lowering infrastructure complexity and total cost of ownership. Remote

------------------

As the **Revenue Enablement & Lifecycle Lead at Arango**, you will build the operating system that makes our go-to-market organization more productive and repeatable as we scale.

You will build the playbooks, onboarding, certifications, coaching frameworks, processes, and automation that help our teams generate pipeline, close business, retain customers, and identify expansion opportunities.

You will work closely with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, and the field to turn best practices into repeatable execution.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Sales Enablement**

* Own and continuously improve sales playbooks for our **Commercial, Enterprise, and Federal** teams
* Build and manage a structured **30/60/90-day onboarding and ramp program** for new sellers
* Partner with Product and Sales Engineering to develop **product, solution, and sales certifications**

* Develop repeatable renewal and expansion playbooks based on customer behavior and account signals
* Partner with RevOps and Customer Success to automate and surface **usage, health, engagement, risk, renewal signals, and expansion triggers** to inform the overall sales process.
* Build a culture of ongoing seller education through recurring training, deal reviews, and field enablement
* Establish a **manager coaching framework** that helps frontline leaders consistently inspect, coach, and improve seller performance
* Measure enablement effectiveness through ramp time, pipeline creation, conversion, renewal retention, productivity, and adoption

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

* 5+ years of experience in **sales enablement, revenue enablement, revenue operations, customer lifecycle operations, or related GTM functions**
* Experience building scalable sales processes and enablement programs within a **B2B SaaS organization**
* Demonstrated experience improving **seller productivity, pipeline generation, deal execution, renewals, or expansion**
* Strong understanding of modern sales methodologies such as **MEDDPICC**
* Experience designing workflows, processes, and automation across CRM and GTM systems
* Ability to translate successful field behavior into **repeatable playbooks and operating processes**

* Strong communication, facilitation, and program-management skills
* Experience driving adoption and behavioral change across a growing sales organization

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

You will make it easier for every seller and manager to know **what good looks like, what to do next, and how to execute consistently**.

Within your first year, Arango should have a repeatable enablement system across each sales motion, a measurable onboarding and certification program, a consistent renewal methodology, automated customer signals, and a proactive process for identifying risk and expansion opportunities.

**What Makes Arango Special?**
------------------------------

At Arango, we believe that AI is only as powerful as the data foundation. Our mission is to help organizations build AI systems that can reason, decide and act based on unified, current, and trusted business context at scale. We are helping define a new category of infrastructure: the contextual data layer for AI.

Working at Arango means:

* Contributing to cutting-edge AI and data infrastructure
* Collaborating with experienced engineers, marketers, and product leaders
* Helping shape how enterprises build AI-powered applications

If you're excited about the intersection of AI, data, and social media, we’d love to hear from you.

Prometheus Federal Services (PFS) is a trusted partner to federal healthcare agencies, seeking a Healthcare Staff Recruiter/Account Manager to join our team to support a complex federal contract with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs/Veterans Health Administration. The incumbent will support our Integrated Critical Staffing Program Management Office with all activities spanning pre- and post-award, with a focus on working with teaming partners and clients across multiple contracts to ensure the successful delivery of services to Veterans.  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations Statement**  
To succeed in this job, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential duty. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.  
  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Supports the development and execution of temporary healthcare staffing solutions to meet program and client needs.
* Serves as a primary point of contact for government stakeholders, ensuring timely communication and issue resolution.
* Builds, strengthens, and manages relationships with a large network of teaming partners across multiple contracts.
* Ensures full compliance with all staffing requirements, credentialing standards, and program criteria.
* Coordinates activities spanning pre-award planning through post-award execution to ensure operational readiness and successful service delivery.
* Monitors performance metrics, identifies risks, and supports continuous improvement efforts across the staffing program.
* Recruits healthcare providers for current and prospective clients, including screening and interviewing candidates, supporting salary negotiations, and guiding selected candidates through the onboarding/credentialing process with support from the PFS ICSP team.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
* Minimum five (5) years of experience working in a healthcare setting.
* Demonstrated experience leading or managing a large partner or vendor network to achieve customer requirements.
* Experience staffing or recruiting under the Service Contract Act (SCA), including familiarity with SCA wage determinations and compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with healthcare staff credentialing, training, and onboarding processes.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Authorized to work in the U.S. indefinitely without sponsorship.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance, if required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing teaming partnerships, vendor relationships, or multi-organization collaboration efforts in a federal contracting environment.

**Compensation & Benefits**

PFS offers a benefits package that may include health, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; disability and life insurance; a retirement plan; paid time off; and other programs to support employees and their families. Learn more about PFS Benefits.  
  
The posted salary range represents PFS's good-faith estimate for this role. Actual compensation offered will be determined by a combination of factors, including but not limited to: the candidate's education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience;internal equity; geographic location; and contract and organizational requirements. PFS is committed to fair, consistent, and equitable compensation practices across the organization, and offers are calibrated to maintain internal pay equity while remaining competitive in the external market.

Salary Range: $71,354 - $100,000

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or other status protected by law.

PFS is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruiting@pfs.us. Reasonable accommodations are available to ensure applicants with disabilities have equal access to the hiring process, in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable laws.

This position may be subject to client‑specific or government‑mandated vaccination, health, or safety requirements, which may change over time.

jobs.title: Senior Design Program Manager II
jobs.description:
**We're transforming the grocery industry**

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

**Overview**
============

Instacart is on a mission to make eating well effortless for everyone and great design is a key ingredient. As a Senior Design Program Manager, you'll drive operational excellence and programmatic execution across the Design organization—building AI-enabled systems, scaling critical processes, and managing the tools and vendor relationships that power our creative work.

This role sits at the intersection of design craft, technical operations, and strategic execution. You'll bring strong design sensibility—whether from product design or design systems—to build scalable programs, automate workflows using AI, and ensure our design team has the infrastructure, tools, and processes to deliver world-class experiences efficiently. You'll work closely with the Instacart Design System (IDS) team, requiring technical fluency to bridge design, engineering, and tooling infrastructure.

**About the Role**
==================

You'll own end-to-end program execution for high-visibility design initiatives while building the operational backbone that enables the Design organization to scale. You'll leverage AI to automate workflows, manage critical vendor relationships (Figma, design tooling, contractors), and create repeatable systems that translate our design, creative and product strategy into shipped experiences.

You'll report to the Director of Technical Program Management and work closely with Design and Product Leadership, Marketing, Engineering, and several other cross-functional partners to deliver outcomes that matter.

**About the Job**
=================

* **Programmatic Execution:** Drive end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-quarter design initiatives across Design, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Business Development and other cross-functional teams. Enable seamless cross-functional collaboration and predictable program outcomes.
* **AI Enablement:** Build and deploy AI-enabled workflows that automate program management tasks—status reporting, resource tracking, documentation synthesis, and stakeholder communication. Champion AI fluency in Design to accelerate design-first thinking and increase operational efficiency.
* **Operations & Vendor Management:** Own strategic vendor relationships and contract management for design tooling (Figma, prototyping, asset management, collaboration platforms). Negotiate contracts, optimize licensing spend, and ensure infrastructure scales with growth. Manage contractor/agency relationships and partner with Finance, Legal, and IT on compliance and cost efficiency.
* **Systems & Tooling:** Champion team health through capacity planning, roadmapping, and resource allocation. Build operational metrics and tooling integrations that create seamless workflows across platforms.
* **Design Systems & Cross-Functional Partnership:** Partner with the Instacart Design System (IDS) team to align programs with system evolution and component adoption. Drive governance programs that scale IDS across product teams. Act as strategic partner to Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Operations. Translate design strategy into executable programs with clear visibility into progress and outcomes. Facilitate planning cycles and milestone reviews where design intersects with product roadmaps.
* **Design Craft Integration:** Apply design thinking and product sense to program design—understanding user needs, designing operational experiences, and iterating based on feedback. Build systems that empower designers and product managers to do their best work while balancing flexibility with consistency, creative exploration with scalable patterns, and craft excellence with business impact.

**About You**
=============

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 6+ years in program management and design operations within design or product organizations, with deep experience driving operational excellence and culture for design and product teams.
* Strong product sense and design craft sensibility, with well-developed methods and tools for driving fluid programs forward into the market.
* Experience with all stages of the product development lifecycle, launching products end-to-end.
* (component libraries, tokens, documentation, cross-platform patterns)

Proven track record driving complex, cross-functional programs from 0* 1 and scaling operational systems in fast-paced environments
* AI fluency: Experience leveraging AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms) to drive efficiency and scale programs
* Vendor/contract management experience: negotiating software contracts, managing relationships, optimizing spend, ensuring compliance

jobs.title: CX Operations Manager
jobs.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

**About the role**
------------------

Grüns is scaling fast, and our customer experience has to scale with it. As CX Operations Manager, you'll own the systems behind how our support team learns, performs, and improves: the knowledge base, training, QA, and the data that shows us where to act next. You'll partner with our BPO leadership and our AI Lead to make every agent sharper and every customer interaction faster and better.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a quarterly basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------

* Own our knowledge base as the single source of truth: accurate, organized, easy to use, and audited on a recurring cadence
* Design and facilitate CX onboarding, training, and continuing education for new and tenured agents, including virtual sessions across time zones, built for every learning style
* Dig into CSAT, NPS, QA, FCR, and AHT data to find gaps in workflows and knowledge, then turn them into specific fixes
* Partner with our internal QA team and BPO leadership on calibrations, 1:1 coaching, and performance improvement plans, serving as the liaison between support leadership and agents
* Build and maintain FAQs and agent macros that drive self-service and agent efficiency
* Work with our AI Lead to identify automation and deflection opportunities, and implement internal tools that improve resolution times and CSAT

**We're looking for someone who:**
----------------------------------

* Has 5+ years in Customer Experience, Support Operations, CX Ops, QA, Training, or Knowledge Management
* Has 2+ years in a managerial role, or an equivalent independent-contributor role with real ownership
* Has worked directly with BPO teams
* Has created and maintained documentation (SOPs, macros, help articles, templates) that a frontline team actually uses
* Has mastered analyzing CX performance reporting: CSAT, quality scoring, contact drivers, first response time, and resolution quality
* Is hands-on with a support platform (Gladly, Zendesk, Gorgias, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud, or similar), a knowledge tool (Notion, Confluence, Guru, or similar), and QA workflows (scorecards, sampling, calibration)
* Is strong in Google Workspace and builds trackers and reporting in Sheets with ease (pivot tables, filters, structured logs)
* Bonus: has used AI tools or built AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code)

**Approach to the role:**
-------------------------

* Runs a regimented cadence: sets the rhythm, hits deadlines, and keeps programs moving without reminders
* Obsesses over clarity: writes things so anyone can execute them and removes ambiguity wherever it hides
* Thinks in patterns: spots repeat issues fast, tags them consistently, and turns them into fixes
* Balances customer-first with policy discipline: empathetic and flexible, but grounded in what we can promise and deliver
* Collaborates without creating drag: brings solutions, not noise
* Leads virtual training with a flexible schedule across time zones, and isn't afraid to take an escalation call when it counts
* Owns the outcome with extreme ownership, with no micromanagement needed and always ten steps ahead

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package—grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is between **$100,000 – $110,000 plus bonus** depending on experience.

Beyond base salary, we offer competitive equity packages and a comprehensive set of benefits designed to support the well-being, growth, and balance of our team.

**A bit about us...**

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There's an infinite number of "nutrition" companies, all focused on what's best for them — not what's best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We've seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

  

**What we care about...**

**Be the Best:** We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

**Own It:** We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

**Drive Impact, Urgently:** We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

  

**Compensation & Perks:**

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage - for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

jobs.title: Program Manager - Authorized Service Provider (ASP)
jobs.description:
**Job Description: ASP Program Manager**

***Fluke Health Solutions*** *· Fluke Biomedical Division · Authorized Service Provider (ASP) Program*

***Reports to:*** *Global Service Sales Leader · Department: Global Service Sales*

**Job Summary:**

The ASP Program Manager owns the day-to-day health, growth, and performance governance of Fluke Health Solutions' global network of Authorized Service Providers (ASPs) — the third-party partners who deliver calibration, repair, and preventive maintenance service on Fluke Biomedical equipment outside of Fluke's direct service footprint.

This role is responsible for the full partner lifecycle: identifying and prioritizing new markets, qualifying and onboarding new ASPs, managing royalty and product-tier authorization structures, and running the ongoing quarterly/annual performance cadence that keeps the existing network reliable, compliant, and financially sound. The role blends program management, partner relationship management, and data-driven decision-making, and is measured on ASP network revenue growth, service quality/SLA compliance, and royalty revenue integrity.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the ASP performance assessment cadence (quarterly, annual, and trigger-based) as defined in the ASP Assessment Standard Work

* Evaluate and prioritize new ASP markets using country-level revenue/opportunity modeling (install base, net incremental revenue, cannibalization risk)

* Score and qualify new ASP candidates against the standard qualification scorecard and Phase 1 audit checklist

* Manage royalty structure selection and reconciliation across the existing ASP portfolio

* Own product tier authorization decisions (which service categories each ASP is certified to perform) and reassess at each quarterly review

* Monitor SLA/turnaround-time performance and loaner pool health across all Tier 2/3 escalations

* Maintain and report on the ASP KPI dashboard (service volume, revenue vs. plan, customer satisfaction, certification status)

* Lead or coordinate process-improvement initiatives affecting the ASP network (e.g., contract renewal process, onboarding workflow)

* Serve as the primary relationship owner for escalated ASP or end-customer issues involving ASP-delivered service

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

* 3-5+ years of experience in channel/partner management, service operations, or program management — medical device, biomedical, or technical equipment industry strongly preferred

* Demonstrated experience managing partner performance against SLAs, KPIs, or contractual scorecards

* Strong financial/analytical skills — comfortable building and interpreting revenue models, royalty structures, and ROI/breakeven analysis

* Excellent relationship management and cross-cultural communication skills, given the global and multi-region nature of the ASP network

* Proficiency with Excel/spreadsheet-based analysis tools; experience with CRM or partner management platforms a plus

**Preferred:**

* Experience with biomedical test equipment, calibration standards (ISO 17025), or quality systems (ISO 9001/13485)

* Experience running or participating in Kaizen / continuous-improvement events

* Prior experience managing international distributor, dealer, or service-partner networks

* Familiarity with royalty or licensing-based partner compensation models

**Fortive Corporation Overview**

Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

**About Fluke Health Solutions**

Comprised of four industry leaders—Fluke Biomedical, LANDAUER, RaySafe, and Victoreen — Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) leads the biomedical and radiation detection markets with innovative products and services that help keep customers, patients, and clients safe. Fluke Biomedical leads the world in manufacturing biomedical test equipment like defibrillator analyzers and digital pressure meters. jobs.description:
**What you would be taking on**

This is an opportunity to get into healthcare technology and work at a fast pace, using AI to speed up how we design, build and deliver.

  

In this role, you would be the person who makes sure we build the right thing the first time. You would connect the business and technology teams across our enterprise applications, with Salesforce at the center. You would lead requirements, process analysis and backlog management across Salesforce, Zuora, Kantata, Gainsight, Marketing Cloud and Boomi integrations. We are looking for a strong analyst first: someone with deep Salesforce experience who applies the same approach to any system.

**Why this role**

* **Shape what gets built.** You would own backlog readiness, so the work our developers pick up starts with your problem statement, your requirements and your acceptance criteria.
* **See the whole business.** You would work with Sales, Finance, Professional Services, Customer Success and Marketing, and follow processes like quote-to-cash and the customer lifecycle across every system they touch.
* **Be part of big changes.** We are rethinking quote-to-cash, including a move from Salesforce CPQ to Revenue Cloud. You would help design how it works.
* **Learn more than one platform.** Salesforce is the center, but you would also work with Zuora, Kantata, Gainsight, Marketing Cloud and Boomi.
* **Use AI every day.** You would have AI tools to draft requirements, map processes and analyze data faster, so more of your time goes to the analysis that needs a person.
* **Set the standard.** You would define how we write requirements and documentation, and help the rest of the team follow it.
* **Work that matters in healthcare.** Veradigm builds technology used by physician practices, health plans and life sciences companies. The systems you improve keep that work running.

**What you will do**

* Manage the intake of business requests: clarify the problem, define scope, assess business value and prepare the work for the delivery backlog.
* Run requirements sessions with stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Professional Services, Customer Success and Marketing.
* Document current-state and future-state business processes, and identify gaps, risks and improvements.
* Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria and process flows in Jira, and maintain supporting documentation in Confluence.
* Own backlog readiness. Make sure work is well-defined, prioritized and ready before sprint planning.
* Take part in Agile Scrum ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.
* Work with developers, admins and QA through delivery. Answer requirements questions, support testing and confirm solutions meet acceptance criteria.
* Analyze cross-system processes and data flows, such as quote-to-cash, professional services delivery and customer lifecycle, across Salesforce, Zuora, Kantata, Gainsight and Boomi integrations.
* Help prioritize work by bringing data, business impact and tradeoffs to stakeholders.
* Set and maintain requirements and documentation standards. Guide stakeholders and other contributors to follow them.
* Influence stakeholders at all levels. Push back constructively on incomplete, conflicting or low-value requests.
Support user acceptance testing, release communications and change management.  

**What we need**

All of these are required:

* 4+ years of business analysis experience with enterprise business applications.
* 3+ of hands-on business analysis on Salesforce, such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud or CPQ.
* Proven ability to apply business analysis skills across multiple platforms and quickly learn new systems.
* Strong experience in Agile Scrum environments, including writing user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence.
* Experience with process mapping and documentation, such as BPMN, swimlane diagrams, Visio or Lucidchart.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
A bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.  

**What helps**

* Salesforce Business Analyst or Administrator certification.
* Experience with Zuora, Kantata, Gainsight, Marketing Cloud or other SaaS business applications.
* Understanding of integration concepts and middleware, such as Boomi or MuleSoft, including data mapping and system dependencies.
* Experience with quote-to-cash, revenue operations, professional services or customer success processes.
* Basic SQL or reporting skills for data analysis.
* Healthcare technology or regulated-industry experience.
CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA or Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) certification.

$84,520-$117,483

* Drive subsidy-funded programs from award and planning through construction completion, service activation and required certification.

* Monitor contractor and vendor performance and escalate issues affecting schedule, budget, funded-location commitments or compliance requirements.

* Track program and location-level milestones across engineering, permitting, construction, service availability and required funding checkpoints.

* Maintain visibility into bottlenecks, aging tasks, location discrepancies, certification dependencies and cross-functional risks.

* Coordinate removal of blockers with engineering, permitting, construction, operations, vendors and Regulatory & External Affairs.

* Partner with FDC leadership to ensure subsidized projects achieve construction completion, service activation and funded-location targets within required timeframes.

* Maintain governance frameworks, documentation standards, escalation paths and workflows for subsidy-funded construction programs.

jobs.description:
For more than 170 years, The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.
  
  
Our Commercial Lines team is currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst in our Worcester, MA location. Position is eligible for Hybrid/Flex work arrangement or remote location. This is a full-time, exempt role.
  
  
**POSITION OVERVIEW:**  
Incumbents serving in the Business Analysis job family are responsible for the collection, development, analysis, documentation, and communication of business needs and requirements. Throughout an assignment, Business Analysts may act like a liaison while they interface and work collaboratively with technology and business organizations. Business Analysts usually assess the needs of the assignment by directly interacting with management, leadership, technology, the business and the customer. Business Analysts are also expected to use their working understanding of information systems, business operations, and processes to analyze requirements, develop specifications, story-boarding and prototyping to facilitate the design of integrated solutions. Their knowledge of business analysis, business processes and project methodologies is applied to all of their assignments. Incumbents in this job family must have a solid understanding of their business partners existing business processes, the key drivers and measures of success for the business, and the short and long-term direction of the business and technology. They assess the needs of a business partner through direct interaction, and look for opportunities to develop and grow the business through effective use of technology. They take a broad perspective to determine how solutions will impact existing work processes and systems, and how to manage the integration. Incumbents must be innovative in identifying, proposing and executing solutions, negotiating requirements across multiple partners or departments, and must have an understanding of project scope management and prototyping. Business Analysts should have a high-level understanding of the overall IT architecture in order to understand the issues and implications of proposed system and hardware solutions.
  
  
**SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST PROJECT COMPLEXITY:**  

* Performs work across multiple initiatives and processes.
* Supports and/or leads highly complex business/technical processes or multiple products, requiring design or integration of technical solutions across multiple departments or lines of business.
* Serves primarily as a subject matter expert and may lead projects of large scope and moderate to high complexity.
* Works independently and leverages resources when needed. Has an understanding of and an ability to apply knowledge of multiple technical business systems.

**IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:**  

* Providing technical expertise across business functions, understanding the relationship between the business and the data and technology that support the business or product.
* Responsible for managing the collection, analysis, documentation and coordination of multiple business and/or technical requirements which may include, but is not limited to: • Facilitating planning sessions with multiple business partners to improve business processes or products Involves using and improving information systems.
* Establishing relationships with one or more business partners by demonstrating expert knowledge of business processes/drivers and technical systems, being proactive, and managing the development and implementation of innovative solutions.
* Providing technical coaching and mentoring to less experienced team members.
* Proactively researches and applies Best Practices to technology solutions for areas of expertise.
* Acts as a resource to less experienced personnel in the application and execution of Best Practices.
* Recommending improvements to Best Practices procedures.
* Working with business partners to define needs to align with business priorities and assess impact on other business processes.
* Leading requirements gathering sessions to identify and articulate needs/requirements i.e. JAD sessions, story-boarding.
* Advising business partners on options, technical limitations, risks and cost vs. benefits and ensuring a structured requirements process for the business is adhered to.
* Leading the development, of structured requirements gathering through various techniques i.e. JAD and storyboarding for the design and implementation of solutions.
* Overseeing the documentation of requirements.
* Participating in the development of prototypes.
* May be accountable for a portion of a project plan in collaboration with project managers, from requirements phases through design, testing, implementation and maintenance.
* Acts as a resource to less experienced personnel in developing and executing test/use cases.
* Defining when to employ automation and determining impact.
* Identifies, recommends and may approve improvements when appropriate.
* Participates, facilitates and leads project meetings/sessions.
* May act as a resource in the design, development, and execution of complex reports and/or report requirements.
* Identifies and recommends improvements when appropriate.
* May analyze and provide production support for more complex or escalated issues.
* Partners with technology development to provide a solution.
* Seeks guidance from more experienced resources when needed.
* May provide support through the warranty period.

* Requires /in-depth knowledge of business operations, requirements processing, business modeling concepts, information systems and project life-cycle knowledge, and business process development.

For more than 170 years, The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.

Our Commercial Lines team is currently seeking a **Senior Business Analyst** in our Worcester, MA location. Position is eligible for Hybrid/Flex work arrangement or remote location. This is a full-time, exempt role.

  

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

Incumbents serving in the Business Analysis job family are responsible for the collection, development, analysis, documentation, and communication of business needs and requirements. Throughout an assignment, Business Analysts may act like a liaison while they interface and work collaboratively with technology and business organizations. Business Analysts usually assess the needs of the assignment by directly interacting with management, leadership, technology, the business and the customer. Business Analysts are also expected to use their working understanding of information systems, business operations, and processes to analyze requirements, develop specifications, story-boarding and prototyping to facilitate the design of integrated solutions. Their knowledge of business analysis, business processes and project methodologies is applied to all of their assignments. Incumbents in this job family must have a solid understanding of their business partners existing business processes, the key drivers and measures of success for the business, and the short and long-term direction of the business and technology. They assess the needs of a business partner through direct interaction, and look for opportunities to develop and grow the business through effective use of technology. They take a broad perspective to determine how solutions will impact existing work processes and systems, and how to manage the integration. Incumbents must be innovative in identifying, proposing and executing solutions, negotiating requirements across multiple partners or departments, and must have an understanding of project scope management and prototyping. Business Analysts should have a high-level understanding of the overall IT architecture in order to understand the issues and implications of proposed system and hardware solutions.

Dropbox is a Virtual First company. For this role, we are hiring in Zones 2 and 3. Zones are determined by your zip code; if you’re within 100 miles of a listed metro area (straight-line radius), you’re included in that Zone. Please

### **Company Description**

Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.

### **Team Description**

The Dropbox Customer Experience and Success (CXS) Team shapes how more than 700 million users and 575k teams worldwide interact with our products. We turn insights into actions, bringing empathy and expertise to every touchpoint. Our team embraces resourcefulness and curiosity, pushing boundaries—and ourselves—to improve the customer experience and ensure our customers achieve their desired outcomes with our products, leading to increased customer lifetime value, retention, and growth. Every team member contributes their unique perspective as we collaborate across the organization to amplify the customer voice. If you're passionate about bringing joy, humanity, and simplicity to how people interact with Dropbox, join our Customer Experience and Success team.

### **Virtual First**

Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.

This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5-10% of the year or 2-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.

### **AI Fluency**

AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.

We look for four key behaviors in candidates:

* **Ownership**: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work.
* **Experimentation:** You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.
* **Leverage:** You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
* **Learning:** You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.

Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.

Dropbox supports responsible use of AI for preparation, but misrepresentation of skills or experience is not permitted.

  
Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner** to drive business requirements, product vision, stakeholder collaboration, and end-to-end delivery of software solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in **business analysis, Product Ownership, requirements management, functional testing, regression testing, UAT, and test case development**.

The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, developers, QA teams, and project leadership to translate business needs into clear functional requirements and ensure solutions meet business and user expectations.

Key Responsibilities

* Serve as a **Product Owner / Senior Business Analyst**, representing business and user needs throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Define and maintain **product vision, roadmap, priorities, and backlog** in collaboration with stakeholders and technical teams.
* Gather, analyze, document, and validate **business and functional requirements**.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, requirements workshops, process analysis, and gap analysis.
* Create detailed **Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and use cases**.
* Translate business requirements into actionable user stories and clearly defined acceptance criteria for development and QA teams.
* Prioritize product backlog based on business value, customer needs, dependencies, and project objectives.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, QA engineers, and business stakeholders throughout the SDLC.

* Experience with **defect management, validation, and resolution tracking**.

* Paid time off
