jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Remote

Full Time

Mid Level

**Hobbs Madison** is a leading consulting firm focused on bridging the gap between business strategy and technology execution. We combine deep technical and management expertise to solve complex challenges, improve capabilities, and drive competitive growth. Our clients include some of the largest banking, insurance and investment firms in the U.S.
  
  
We are looking for a Business Analyst with strong data management experience in the financial services industry. This position offers the opportunity to work on complex enterprise data initiatives for large financial institutions, with an initial focus on Customer and Party Master Data Management (MDM).
  
  
You will partner closely with our clients’ business and technical teams to identify business use cases and develop the functional blueprint for how customer data is governed, mastered, and distributed across the organization. You will translate business needs into functional requirements, document current and future-state processes, and help define data governance, quality, and stewardship models that support enterprise MDM initiatives.
  
  
This is a Remote, Full-Time position with the possibility of some travel.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with client stakeholders to identify and document prioritized Customer and Party MDM business use cases, business benefits, success criteria, and KPIs.
* Lead interviews and working sessions with business users, subject matter experts, data owners, and technical teams to gather and translate business needs into functional requirements.
* Analyze current-state business processes and data environments to define future-state requirements for customer master data.
* Develop functional MDM blueprints outlining how customer data will be governed, mastered, maintained, and distributed across the enterprise.
* Create current-state and future-state data flow maps and source-to-user inventories to document how customer data moves across business functions and systems.
* Define business requirements for data quality, including quality rules, controls, monitoring, remediation workflows, and auditability.
* Document business requirements for entity resolution, matching, survivorship, and related processes used to establish trusted customer records.
* Help define target-state data governance models, including data ownership, stewardship responsibilities, decision rights, and issue management workflows.
* Support the development of MDM implementation roadmaps, priorities, dependencies, and mobilization plans.
* Prepare business requirements, process flows, functional documentation, presentations, and recommendations for client teams and leadership.

**About You**

* You have 5+ years of Business Analyst experience, preferably supporting data management, MDM, data governance, or enterprise data initiatives.
* You have experience working directly within financial services or consulting for banking and financial services clients.
* You have strong experience interviewing business stakeholders, identifying business needs, and translating those needs into clear functional requirements and use cases.
* You understand Master Data Management concepts, preferably Customer or Party MDM, and how master data supports business processes across an organization.
* You have experience with current-state and future-state analysis, business process mapping, data flow mapping, and requirements documentation.
* You understand data governance, data stewardship, metadata, lineage, and audit trail concepts.
* You are familiar with data quality frameworks, remediation workflows, entity resolution, matching, and survivorship concepts.
* Experience with AI-based approaches to data quality, entity resolution, record matching, or data disambiguation is highly preferred.
* You communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders and are comfortable facilitating client interviews and collaborative working sessions.
* You have a track record of working successfully in a remote consulting environment and managing multiple priorities with limited day-to-day supervision.
* You work effectively within mixed teams of client stakeholders, consultants, technical specialists, and subject matter experts.
* You have strong PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and Visio skills and are comfortable developing client-ready documentation and process flows.
* Experience with Jira and SharePoint is preferred.

**Our History**

Founded in 2002, Hobbs Madison Inc. is a consulting firm specializing in technology and business solutions for the financial services industry. We partner with leading banks, insurance companies, and investor services firms to maximize existing platforms, implement innovative solutions, and deliver results quickly.

Our senior consultants average 15+ years of industry and technology experience, combining technical expertise, business insight, and clear communication to solve complex challenges. Known for our speed, precision, and collaborative approach, we help clients navigate change, improve capabilities, and strengthen their competitive edge.

Hobbs Madison has established a reputation among its clients as one of the leading Strategy and IT Consultants in the U.S. for the financial services industry.

You will serve as the bridge between marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and finance, so that every team works from the same numbers and the same definitions.

If you love building systems that scale, untangling messy data, and giving teams reports they can trust, this role is for you.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Stack Roadmap:** Maintain a documented map of the marketing stack (owners, costs, renewal dates, integrations) and plan where it should go next, including AI and automation tools that help a lean team move faster.

**Data, Analytics & Attribution**
---------------------------------

* **Lead Scoring & Routing:** Build and maintain fit and engagement scoring models and routing logic so high-intent leads reach the right salespeople quickly, with clear follow-up SLAs across regions.

**Campaign & Process Optimization**
-----------------------------------

* **Lifecycle Marketing:** Standardize the funnel stages (Lead ➔ MQL ➔ SQL ➔ Opportunity ➔ Closed-Won) with clear definitions, entry and exit criteria, and handoff rules, so sales and marketing speak the same language.
* **Campaign Operations:** Own campaign setup standards, including UTM conventions, naming taxonomy, HubSpot campaign objects, and Salesforce campaign hierarchy, so every program is tracked consistently from launch.
* **A/B Testing Frameworks:** Set up clean tracking for marketing experiments across email, landing pages, and paid media, with agreed success metrics and sample sizes, so teams can trust their test results.
* **Playbook Creation:** Document internal processes, from campaign launch checklists to lead management rules, so the marketing team can scale without losing efficiency.
* **Global Operations:** Build processes that work across regions (Americas, EMEA, APAC), including localized forms, regional consent requirements, and routing for international teams.

* **Funnel & Pipeline Reporting:** Build dashboards for marketing, sales leadership, and executives covering MQL volume, stage conversion rates, speed to lead, marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline, and closed-won revenue.
* **Channel Reporting:** Track performance across paid media, email, website, social, events, and content, from spend and engagement to the leads and pipeline each channel produces.
* **Budget & ROI:** Partner with finance to track spend against budget and report on CAC, cost per MQL, cost per opportunity, and ROI by channel and campaign.
* **Planning & Enablement:** Support annual and quarterly planning with funnel math tied to pipeline targets, run weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting reviews, and train marketing and sales teams on HubSpot and reporting.

### **WHO YOU ARE**

**Who You Are**

* Expert-level HubSpot administration skills; HubSpot certifications are a plus.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience, including the HubSpot–Salesforce integration, campaign objects, and lead and contact management.

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are hiring a Deal and Contract Operations Manager to join our Business Operations team in San Francisco. In this role, you will design and own the end-to-end deal and contracting processes mainly by supporting and training deal owners on contracting workflows, including operational ownership of our contracting tool, acting as the escalation point before deals get stuck, coordinating across internal approver teams such as Legal, Tax, and Finance to keep deals moving forward, and ensuring every signed partner has a smooth onboarding experience by involving the right stakeholders pre- and post-close.  
  
Because you sit at the center of every deal, you will have a unique vantage point to spot what needs to be standardized, automated, or tooled across the deal lifecycle, and coordinate with the rest of the functions under Bizops (i.e. Sales Ops, Order Management, Business Systems etc.) to make it happen. You will use that perspective to build frameworks, drive process automation, and continuously reduce the time it takes to get from contract signing to customer onboarding, ensuring downstream teams like Partner Success, Order Management, and Logistics are engaged at the right time.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and maintain the end-to-end contract operations processes, from template selection support through approval alongside Legal so that deal owners (i.e. Business Development and Partner Success teams) can move deals through the process efficiently and with minimal friction.
* Project-manage deals from contract signing through customer onboarding, ensuring downstream teams (Partner Success, Order Management, RevOps, Logistics) are engaged at the right time prior to deal close, and that non-standard terms are highlighted and passed along to the correct stakeholders.
* Troubleshoot Contract Lifecycle Management (i.e.) workflow issues, advise on routing and approvals, and unblock bottlenecks so deal owners can keep momentum.
* Train and equip Business Development teams to be self-sufficient in the contracting process: how to create CLM workflows, select the right contract template and deal term configuration, route to the correct approvers, and anticipate approval requirements
* Ensure contract templates are properly created and maintained within the CLM system in adherence with the Amazon policy, and assist Business Development with escalating redlines to Legal and driving alignment on accepted terms.
* Use your centralized vantage point across all deals to spot patterns and identify what needs to be standardized, automated, or tooled, translating those insights into process improvements that make the entire deal lifecycle faster and more consistent.
* Lead process automation initiatives with the goal of decreasing contract throughput time and increasing deal signing velocity.
* Develop lightweight tooling and streamlined processes for higher-frequency, lower-complexity deals (e.g., direct Enterprise deals), including enabling 3P sales reps to independently handle NDAs and select contracting workflows on our behalf.
* Develop AI-based mechanisms to handle specialized deals with exception approvals for non-standard requests.
* Collaborate closely with Sales Ops and Order Management to feed process automation ideas and ensure the right tooling gets built to reduce manual effort across the deal-to-onboarding lifecycle.
* Continuously improve the onboarding experience for B2B customers by removing avoidable friction points, with decreasing time-to-onboard as a key success metric.

new_jobs.title: Strategic Operations Associate, Catering
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
This operations role sits within Uber for Business - one of Uber's fastest growing business units in terms of topline performance. Within this org, you'll join the founding team responsible for building and scaling Catering. Catering is an exciting strategic priority across both Uber for Business and the Delivery organization as a whole, changing the ways in which consumers and business customers use UberEats.  
  
Working alongside the U4B Head of Catering, you'll play a central role in making Catering expansion repeatable across markets. This will consist of operationalizing launch frameworks, coordinating market readiness across regional and global stakeholders, supporting market and account opportunity analysis, and identifying where local requirements require changes to the playbook. Sitting at the intersection of Strategy, Operations, Sales and regional Delivery teams, you'll help define how Catering scales from a small pilot product into a core part of Uber's business across the Globe.  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Market Launch Execution: Own the operational cadence for Catering launches across new markets, translating established launch frameworks into clear work plans, milestones, owners, and readiness criteria.
* Market Readiness: Coordinate cross-functional readiness across U4B, regional Delivery Strategy & Operations, Sales, Operations, and other local stakeholders to ensure each market is prepared to launch.
* Expansion Planning: Support market and account opportunity analysis, including book-building and lead identification, to help determine where and how Catering should expand.
* Playbook Iteration: Identify patterns and deviations across markets, distinguish local requirements from systemic gaps, and continuously improve the expansion playbook based on launch learnings.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Drive clear communication, issue resolution, and escalation across global and regional stakeholders while independently solving problems within the established framework.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience: At least 2 years of experience in program management, operations, strategy, launch operations, enablement operations, or a related field.
* Program Management: Strong organizational and execution skills, with experience managing multiple work streams, stakeholders, milestones, and dependencies at once.
* Structured Problem Solving: Ability to apply an established framework to new situations, identify meaningful deviations, and determine which issues can be solved directly versus escalated.
* Analytical Skills: Comfort working with business data to support market prioritization, performance monitoring, and operational decision-making.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across global, regional, and cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor's Degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Launch and Expansion Experience: Experience supporting multi-market launches, geographic expansion, or repeatable operational programs.
* Uber or Marketplace Knowledge: Familiarity with Uber, Delivery, U4B, or marketplace operating models is helpful but not required.
* Process Improvement: Demonstrated ability to identify recurring friction, improve operating processes, and make established programs more scalable over time.
* Technical & Analytical Skills: Comfortability with basic Uber-preferred AI tools including ChatGPT and Claude/Cortana.
* Adaptability: Comfort operating in a fast-moving, evolving environment, taking ownership of execution while maintaining strong judgment on when to escalate.

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $106,000 per year - USD $118,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $106,000 per year - USD $118,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Description:

The Street Health Outreach program is an innovative project which identifies and assists people in the Central Alameda County who are experiencing homelessness and have chronic health and mental health needs. The Street Health Outreach Team supports clients to attain housing stability and improve health and well-being.

Using a multi-disciplined team approach, the program provides street and venue-based outreach and engagement, assessment, health services and triage, case management, linkages to housing agencies and mental health services. The program will work with all participants to develop and carry out action plans that improve health and wellness.

Under the supervision of the Street Health Outreach Program Director, the **Street Health Outreach Behavioral Health Case Manager I** will work directly with participants in conducting evidence-based behavioral health assessments, health coaching, and supporting clients with navigating mental health and substance use treatment systems from a harm reduction and trauma-informed approach.

**Schedule:** This is a full-time position, working 40 hours per week, typically Monday through Friday, with occasional Saturday hours.

**About TVHC:** Tiburcio Vasquez Health Center is a nonprofit community health center dedicated to promoting the health and well-being of our community by providing accessible, high-quality care through the integration of primary care, dental care, WIC support, mental health counseling, community health education, and more.

**Benefits:** We offer excellent benefits, including: medical (100% paid co-payments, premiums, etc.), dental, vision (including dependent and domestic partner coverage), generous paid leave benefits including holidays, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement plans with an Employer match, tuition reimbursement, monthly treats, pet insurance, and more.

**Compensation:** $32.19 - $35.17 per hour, depending on experience.

*This position is represented by SEIU, with compensation and benefits determined by the terms of the Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA). Salary is based on the wage scales outlined in the agreement. Beyond base pay, TVHC provides a comprehensive compensation package that supports the health, wealth, and career development of our employees.*

### **Responsibilities:**

* Conduct behavioral health assessments, provide health coaching, triage clients, triage and support clients with navigating mental health and substance use treatment systems.
* Maintain a caseload of clients who are identified to need more in-depth case management services.
* Provide outreach and engagement, health services and triage, and collaboration with Housing Resource Centers.
* Build relationships over time via consistent visits with patients and potential patients.
* Screen and identify individuals with medical and behavioral needs.
* Prioritize individuals with high medical and behavioral health needs and/or Substance Use Disorders for intensive visits to improve health and lift them out of homelessness.
* Participate in regular meetings with Alameda County Healthcare for the Homeless.
* Provide culturally competent, trauma informed, and harm reduction-based services.

* Demonstrated ability to build the trust and respect of patients, staff, colleagues, external contacts, and other organizational members.

**Who we are:** La Clínica de La Raza is a community-based health center committed to providing culturally appropriate, high-quality, and accessible health care to the diverse communities of the San Francisco Bay Area. As health care activists, we are dedicated to making sure individuals who do not have health coverage get the same level of quality healthcare as those who have it. From our genesis as a community health center in 1971, we understood that we cannot heal our communities without also addressing the economic and social factors that affect health. Many times, this requires that we go outside and provide services in other settings to build the bridge that links individuals to our health center for preventive and primary care. Over 90,000 individuals come to La Clínica because it is a welcoming place that addresses the whole person, coordinating and connecting them to a broad network of services to improve and maintain their health and wellbeing. While we are still known for our activism and spirit of social justice, we are also proud to have grown into a sophisticated provider of primary health care services with 35 sites across Alameda, Contra Costa and Solano counties.

new_jobs.description:
For over a century, the **Workers' Compensation Insurance Rating Bureau of California (WCIRB)** has been California's trusted, objective provider of actuarially based information and research, advisory pure premium rates and educational services integral to a healthy workers' compensation system. The WCIRB is a California unincorporated, private, nonprofit association comprised of all companies licensed to transact workers' compensation insurance in California. The operations of the WCIRB are funded primarily by membership fees and assessments; no state money is used to fund its operations. The WCIRB is a stable company and a proven leader in the workers’ compensation insurance industry nationwide.

The WCIRB performs a number of functions to accurately measure the cost of providing workers' compensation benefits and ensure a healthy workers’ compensation system. To learn more about our company, please visit About Us | WCIRB California. The WCIRB employs approximately 175 people with an average tenure of over 10 years. We are committed to fostering a healthy, safe and diverse work environment leading to a dedicated, collaborative and innovative workforce. This is a **hybrid position** where approximately 40% of the work time is spent at the home office in San Francisco, California.

**Job Summary**

The **Member Services Associate Analyst** is responsible for ensuring the accuracy of workers’ compensation policy and loss data, and for the accurate calculation and timely publication of experience modifications for eligible employers in California. The Associate Analyst assists insurers in complying with the California Insurance Commissioner’s regulations outlined in the California Workers’ Compensation Uniform Statistical Reporting Plan—1995 and the California Workers’ Compensation Experience Rating Plan—1995, as they pertain to data reporting, experience rating and ownership. This is an entry level position for new staff and does not require any prior knowledge of insurance or workers’ compensation regulations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provides verbal and written coaching and guidance to data reporters to resolve systemic data reporting issues and improve data quality.
* Collaborates frequently with team members, leadership, and other internal stakeholders to identify and resolve customer data reporting issues.
* Performs analytical research to determine proper ownership and combinability of entities; taking the requisite steps to ensure experience modifications are applied correctly to all impacted policies following ownership decision.

**Education and Experience**

**Perks & Benefits**  
Our employees enjoy a state of the art, energy-efficient, open work environment that nurtures collaboration and creativity. At the WCIRB, we go the extra mile to keep our employees happy and healthy.

Proud to be recognized as a Plan Sponsor of the Year finalist for our commitment to retirement readiness through strong 401k and pension offerings.

* Medical, dental and vision benefits
* Competitive PTO Program
* Wellness benefits
* 401K and pension plan
* Social activities

WCIRB is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. **Project Manager**

Program Management | Full-Time, Salaried | Reports to the Co-CEOs

**Company** Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

**Location** Remote, anywhere in the USA.

**Compensation** $75,000 to $105,000 base.

**Travel** Occasional travel to Las Vegas for quarterly planning and major project kickoffs.

**About the Role**

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas.

We are hiring a Project Manager to join our Program Management team, reporting directly to the Co-CEOs. You will work side by side with our Director of Program Management, the senior member of the team, and take full ownership of a slate of live projects across engineering, product, AI, and marketing.

Your job is delivery. You take each project from intake to closeout: scope, plan, schedule, risks, dependencies, status, and the retrospective at the end. On any project you own, leadership always knows where it stands and the team always knows what happens next.

Technical work runs in Jira. Marketing work runs in Monday. Documentation lives in Confluence. You work fluently across all three.

**Who Should Apply**

We are especially open to candidates from these backgrounds:

* Project Managers at software, digital, or product companies who have run several concurrent projects and can show the numbers they moved
* Technical Project Managers who have delivered engineering work and are comfortable coordinating with marketing
* Agency or professional services Project Managers who have owned SOWs, scope changes, and client reporting and want to go in-house
* Marketing or Growth Operations professionals who have grown into full-lifecycle project ownership

Titles vary. A track record of shipping on time is the bar.

**What You'll Find on Day One**

* Operations and technical teams actively running their work in Jira, with sprints, boards, and owners in place
* A backlog of legacy epics from projects abandoned as far back as seven years ago, ready to be reviewed and cleaned up
* Marketing projects running in Monday, with hand-offs to engineering that need a clear owner
* A draft intake and governance framework that needs to be tested on real projects
* A Director of Program Management as your senior teammate, and Co-CEOs who read project status every week
* Permission to fix what you find. If a workflow is slowing delivery, you change it.

**What You'll Own**

**Project Delivery, End to End**

* Own a slate of concurrent projects from intake through closeout. Write the project charter for each: objective, success metric, sponsor, scope, milestones, and budget where one applies.
* Break scope into a work breakdown, a realistic schedule, and a critical path. Keep baselines honest as the work evolves.
* Choose the delivery approach that fits the work: predictive, Agile, or hybrid.
* Run kickoffs, working sessions, and project standups for the projects you own. Facilitate sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives where a team needs them.
* Close every project with a retrospective and a lessons-learned entry in Confluence.

**Scope, Change, and Risk Control**

* Guard scope. Every change request gets a written impact on timeline, cost, and resources, and a named decision-maker.
* Maintain a RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) for every project. Surface each risk early with a proposed mitigation.
* Map dependencies between engineering and marketing and resolve them before they become blockers.
* Manage vendor and contractor deliverables against their statements of work.

**Status, Reporting, and Stakeholder Communication**

* Publish a weekly status for each project: health, progress against milestones, risks, and decisions needed. Short, specific, and read once.
* Feed accurate project-level data into the portfolio view the Director of Program Management presents to the Co-CEOs.
* Tailor communication to the audience. An engineer, a marketer, and a Co-CEO each get the level of detail they need.
* Escalate early when a project is at risk. Bring the problem, the options, and your recommendation.

**Tool Hygiene and Process Improvement**

* Keep every project you own clean in Jira and Monday: named owners, due dates, current status, and a definition of done.
* Lead the cleanup of legacy epics from abandoned projects. Confirm status with the original teams, archive or close what is finished or dead, and re-plan anything that still matters.
* Apply the draft intake and governance framework on live projects and report back on what works and what needs to change.
* Build templates, checklists, and runbooks so each new project starts faster than the last.

**Supporting the OKR Cadence**

* Link each of your projects to the Key Result it serves, so every project has a clear line to a company objective.
* Support the Director of Program Management in running quarterly OKR planning and weekly check-ins in Monday: prepare the data, collect updates, and track follow-ups to closure.

**Required Qualifications**

* Three or more years of hands-on project management experience delivering software, digital, or marketing projects, with several projects running at once.
* A delivery record you can quantify. On-time rates, cycle times, defect rates, or budget performance you improved, and by how much.
* Command of core project management practice: charters, schedules, critical path, RAID logs, change control, and stakeholder management.
* Comfortable running Agile, predictive, and hybrid delivery, and choosing the right approach for the work.
* Hands-on experience with Jira and a work management platform such as Monday or Asana. You will operate fluently in Jira, Monday, and Confluence within your first 60 days.
* Accountability with warmth. You hold engineers, marketers, and leaders to their commitments, and they come away feeling helped. References on this will be checked.

This **Denver-based role** is a hybrid adventure! You'll join the team in our Denver office at least **two days a week** to collaborate, connect, and create together. Whether you're already in the Denver area or planning to relocate, we'd love to hear from you-as long as you can comfortably make it in for those in-office days.

**About KHM**  
Karsh Hagan Madden (KHM) is an independent marketing agency formed through the merger of Karsh Hagan and Madden Media with 5 decades of creative and strategic legacy with 1 unified shop!

We blend bold storytelling with precision media, PR, geospatial targeting, and observation-led strategy to help brands close the gap between how they are seen and how they are felt. Madden built our reputation in destination marketing and tourism. Karsh has spent years building brands in healthcare, banking, higher education, and retail alongside it. Together, we believe the strongest brands build communities, and our goal is to differentiate them in a world where consumers want something that means something to them.

Find out more at https://khm.agency/  
  
**About You**  
You're an organized, proactive problem-solver who enjoys bringing order to moving pieces and keeping projects on track. You're comfortable balancing the details of day-to-day project management while still seeing the bigger picture-how timelines, resources, budgets, and decisions connect across an account.

You communicate clearly, stay calm when priorities shift, and aren't afraid to ask questions, flag concerns, or jump in to find a better way forward. You're naturally curious about how things work and energized by finding efficiencies, improving processes, and helping teams do their best work.

Most importantly, you're a collaborative team player who enjoys working across disciplines and building strong relationships with the people around you.

**About the Job**  
We're looking for a Project Manager with 3+ years of experience to help lead projects from kickoff through final delivery while contributing to the continued evolution of our agency processes.

You'll work closely with Project Management, Account Service, Creative, Media, and Production teams to keep information flowing, timelines moving, resources aligned, and deliverables on track. You'll become deeply familiar with your projects-understanding not only what needs to happen next, but how decisions around timing, staffing, scope, and budget can impact the overall success of the work.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, connecting the dots across teams, and finding smarter, more efficient ways to get great work out the door.

**What You'll Be Doing**

  

* Lead projects from kickoff through final delivery, maintaining a clear understanding of scope, timelines, resources, budgets, and overall project health.
* Create and maintain project plans, timelines, requirements, trackers, presentations, standard operating procedures, and other internal and client-facing materials.
* Maintain accurate, real-time project information within our project management system and use that information to help inform staffing, resource allocation, and timeline adjustments.
* Coordinate project kickoffs, internal creative reviews, client presentations, and other key internal and external meetings while keeping communication flowing across teams.
* Partner with Production and Media teams to manage specifications, deadlines, routing, trafficking, and delivery of final creative assets and materials.
* Anticipate roadblocks and dependencies, proactively solving challenges before they impact timelines, deliverables, staffing, budgets, or overall account success.
* Help solve operational and project challenges across departments with a thoughtful, solutions-oriented approach.
* Stay current on project management practices, tools, technologies, and industry trends and recommend opportunities to improve agency processes and efficiencies.

**What You Need to Succeed**

* 3+ years of project management experience within an advertising agency, marketing operations, or print/digital asset production environment.
* A foundational understanding of print and digital asset production processes and technical specifications.
* Hands-on experience with project management and collaboration platforms such as Monday.com, Asana, Workamajig, Slack, and Google Workspace.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in both in-person and remote environments.
* Excellent organization and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities.
* The ability to self-manage, exercise good judgment, and recognize when to escalate concerns or ask for support.
* A curious, adaptable mindset with a desire to continuously learn, ask questions, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Experience with analytics or business intelligence tools, such as Google Analytics or Salesforce Reporting, is a plus.

**Don't Meet Every Requirement?**  
That's okay! At Karsh Hagan Madden, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make us stronger. If this role excites you but your skillset doesn't line up perfectly with the qualifications above, we still want to hear from you. Who knows-you might bring something to the table we didn't even know we needed.  
  
**PerksBenefits**

* Competitive compensation.
* Medical, dental, vision, and additional benefits to support you and your family.
* 401(k) with Traditional and Roth options, plus a company match.
* Flexible PTO and paid holidays.
* The tools and technology you need to do your best work.

**Come for the Work. Stay for the People**

* At Karsh Hagan Madden, we're passionate about doing great work-and having fun while we do it. Here's what you can expect:
* A supportive team that's invested in your success.

new_jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager - Enterprise Implementation (Delivery Lead)
new_jobs.description:
Plexlane - contract role with a confidential client (Group IT / PMO)

Location: Remote (United States), US Eastern hours preferred, with occasional onsite as the program requires.

Employment type: Contract via Plexlane, 1099 - no third-party / corp-to-corp employers.

Work authorization: US Citizen or US Green Card (no sponsorship).

About the role

Plexlane is staffing a senior Project Manager to lead day-to-day delivery of a large enterprise application implementation (a SaaS asset, equipment and fleet maintenance management platform) for a construction / equipment-intensive client's Operations & Engineering teams. You are the delivery engine of the program - you own the plan and drive every party to it, operating with executive presence and minimal oversight.

What you'll do

- Own the integrated program plan, schedule, RAID log, dependencies, and budget tracking.

- Lead delivery across the client's Business and IT teams, the software vendor, and other delivery partners.

- Coordinate configuration, data onboarding, integrations, testing/UAT, and deployment readiness performed by the vendor and client.

- Run the governance cadence - weekly written status, steering reviews, and executive reporting.

- Drive scope and change control, risk and issue resolution, and go-live readiness.

Must-haves

- 8+ years leading IT project delivery with full ownership of scope, schedule, budget, and risk.

- Delivered at least one large enterprise implementation end-to-end (ERP, CMMS/EAM, WMS/TMS, or a comparable enterprise platform).

- Proven ability to lead and drive a multi-party program (client business + IT + software vendor) with strong executive presence.

- Strong PM tooling and methods - MS Project/Smartsheet, Jira, Waterfall/Agile, RAID governance.

- US work authorization (no sponsorship); available during US Eastern business hours.

Nice-to-haves

- Operations, engineering, industrial, construction, or field-service environment experience.

- CMMS / asset & fleet maintenance platforms (e.g., Clue); PMP / PgMP; Lean Six Sigma.

About Plexlane

Plexlane is an AI-enabled IT, security and transformation consulting and managed-services firm that staffs and delivers contract engagements for its clients. Plexlane is an equal opportunity employer.

Application Question(s):

* This is a 1099 contract role (no corp-to-corp / third-party employers). Are you able to work on a 1099 basis?
* How many years have you led IT project delivery with full ownership of scope, schedule, and budget (not as a coordinator or business analyst)?
* Describe the single largest enterprise system implementation you personally led - name the system (e.g., ERP, CMMS/EAM, WMS/TMS) AND the company, and your exact role. Answers that will not name the system or company cannot be considered.
* Which CMMS or asset/fleet maintenance platforms have you worked with, if any (e.g., Clue)?
* Are you a US Citizen or US Green Card holder? (This role cannot provide visa sponsorship.)

Work Location: Remote

DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

**Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

**Position Title:** Program Manager of Technical Development

**Position Location:** Remote – work virtually from anywhere in the United States. Must be located near a major US airport.

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Program Manager of Technical Development is responsible for the technical quality, standards, and capability of the Field Services workforce. This role ensures that commissioning execution is technically rigorous and consistent across all projects and sites — not dependent on the expertise of specific individuals — by developing field competency, owning technical standards and SOPs, and driving continuous improvement of processes and workflows.

This role's primary objective is to ensure the technical execution of commissioning work is correct, consistent, and scalable across all Field Services programs, and to build a workforce technically capable of handling complex systems and abnormal conditions without dependency on a small group of senior experts.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

***About Finger Lakes Community Health:***

Finger Lakes Community Health (FLCH) was founded in 1989 with an original mission of serving the region's agricultural workers by linking individuals to area resources and providing essential health services. In 2009 the organization expanded to become a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC), serving patients of all incomes, ethnicities, and walks of life. Over the last decade, FLCH has grown to provide medical, dental, and behavioral health services to over 28,000 patients at eight health centers. With over 200 employees we strive to provide high-quality and innovative health care services to the Finger Lakes Region.

***Benefits Offered:***

* Monday through Friday schedule, closed all major holidays
* Medical insurance with a 90%+ employer contribution
* Dental, Vision, and Life insurance
* Safe Harbor 3% 401k contribution
* Robust PTO offerings
* Education reimbursement

  

***Job Summary:***

  

The Call Center Representative is responsible for providing quality customer service to individuals calling Finger Lakes Community Health. This position ensures callers have their requests handled promptly and are directed to the appropriate departments.

  

***Main Responsibilities:***

***General Call Handling***

* Greet callers with the appropriate call center contact script
* Verify patient account information

* Answer questions and provide general information about Finger Lakes Community Health services
* Route calls to appropriate Finger Lakes Community Health department
* Address caller requests including but not limited to:

* + Scheduling an appointment
  + Refilling a prescription
  + Acute symptoms
  + Registering as a new patient
  + Outside provider, hospital, or pharmacy calls

* Prioritize patient needs with provider availability when scheduling as determined by scheduling guidelines
* Escalate calls following call center guidelines to ensure emergency and acute requests are replied to in a timely manner
* Contact patients directly to schedule appointments and provide information as directed by provider, telephone encounters, actions, or call center management
* Perform tasks efficiently to achieve identified call center metrics
* Review call center metrics with department to identify areas of concern or improvement needed

* Assist with call center coverage at various Finger Lakes Community Health sites as needed
* Other duties as assigned

***Documentation***

* Maintain comprehensive record of caller interactions through telephone encounters, actions, and referrals in the electronic health record system
* Address telephone encounters and actions in the electronic health record system in accordance with Finger Lakes Community Health policies and procedures

  

***Education and Qualifications*****:**

  

* Highschool Diploma or GED
* Customer service experience preferred, but not required
The ability to work flexible hours* - some evenings are required
* The ability to communicate fluently in both Spanish and English is strongly preferred

  

***Physical Requirements:***

* Must be able to hear and communicate with clients and staff via phone, web media, and in person.
* Must be able to lift up to 40 lbs.
* Must be able to sit for extended periods of time
* Must be able to kneel, crawl, or bend into awkward spaces
* OSHA Level 3

new_jobs.description:
For more than 170 years, The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.
  
  
Our Commercial Lines team is currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst in our Worcester, MA location. Position is eligible for Hybrid/Flex work arrangement or remote location. This is a full-time, exempt role.
  
  
**POSITION OVERVIEW:**  
Incumbents serving in the Business Analysis job family are responsible for the collection, development, analysis, documentation, and communication of business needs and requirements. Throughout an assignment, Business Analysts may act like a liaison while they interface and work collaboratively with technology and business organizations. Business Analysts usually assess the needs of the assignment by directly interacting with management, leadership, technology, the business and the customer. Business Analysts are also expected to use their working understanding of information systems, business operations, and processes to analyze requirements, develop specifications, story-boarding and prototyping to facilitate the design of integrated solutions. Their knowledge of business analysis, business processes and project methodologies is applied to all of their assignments. Incumbents in this job family must have a solid understanding of their business partners existing business processes, the key drivers and measures of success for the business, and the short and long-term direction of the business and technology. They assess the needs of a business partner through direct interaction, and look for opportunities to develop and grow the business through effective use of technology. new_jobs.title: Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Remote

Full Time

Mid Level

**Hobbs Madison** is a leading consulting firm focused on bridging the gap between business strategy and technology execution. We combine deep technical and management expertise to solve complex challenges, improve capabilities, and drive competitive growth. Our clients include some of the largest banking, insurance and investment firms in the U.S.
  
  
We are looking for a Business Analyst with strong data management experience in the financial services industry. This position offers the opportunity to work on complex enterprise data initiatives for large financial institutions, with an initial focus on Customer and Party Master Data Management (MDM).
  
  
You will partner closely with our clients’ business and technical teams to identify business use cases and develop the functional blueprint for how customer data is governed, mastered, and distributed across the organization. You will translate business needs into functional requirements, document current and future-state processes, and help define data governance, quality, and stewardship models that support enterprise MDM initiatives.
  
  
This is a Remote, Full-Time position with the possibility of some travel.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with client stakeholders to identify and document prioritized Customer and Party MDM business use cases, business benefits, success criteria, and KPIs.
* Lead interviews and working sessions with business users, subject matter experts, data owners, and technical teams to gather and translate business needs into functional requirements.
* Analyze current-state business processes and data environments to define future-state requirements for customer master data.
* Develop functional MDM blueprints outlining how customer data will be governed, mastered, maintained, and distributed across the enterprise.
* Create current-state and future-state data flow maps and source-to-user inventories to document how customer data moves across business functions and systems.
* Define business requirements for data quality, including quality rules, controls, monitoring, remediation workflows, and auditability.
* Document business requirements for entity resolution, matching, survivorship, and related processes used to establish trusted customer records.
* Help define target-state data governance models, including data ownership, stewardship responsibilities, decision rights, and issue management workflows.
* Support the development of MDM implementation roadmaps, priorities, dependencies, and mobilization plans.
* Prepare business requirements, process flows, functional documentation, presentations, and recommendations for client teams and leadership.

**About You**

* You have 5+ years of Business Analyst experience, preferably supporting data management, MDM, data governance, or enterprise data initiatives.
* You have experience working directly within financial services or consulting for banking and financial services clients.
* You have strong experience interviewing business stakeholders, identifying business needs, and translating those needs into clear functional requirements and use cases.
* You understand Master Data Management concepts, preferably Customer or Party MDM, and how master data supports business processes across an organization.
* You have experience with current-state and future-state analysis, business process mapping, data flow mapping, and requirements documentation.
* You understand data governance, data stewardship, metadata, lineage, and audit trail concepts.
* You are familiar with data quality frameworks, remediation workflows, entity resolution, matching, and survivorship concepts.
* Experience with AI-based approaches to data quality, entity resolution, record matching, or data disambiguation is highly preferred.
* You communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders and are comfortable facilitating client interviews and collaborative working sessions.
* You have a track record of working successfully in a remote consulting environment and managing multiple priorities with limited day-to-day supervision.
* You work effectively within mixed teams of client stakeholders, consultants, technical specialists, and subject matter experts.
* You have strong PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and Visio skills and are comfortable developing client-ready documentation and process flows.
* Experience with Jira and SharePoint is preferred.

**Our History**

Founded in 2002, Hobbs Madison Inc. is a consulting firm specializing in technology and business solutions for the financial services industry. We partner with leading banks, insurance companies, and investor services firms to maximize existing platforms, implement innovative solutions, and deliver results quickly.

Our senior consultants average 15+ years of industry and technology experience, combining technical expertise, business insight, and clear communication to solve complex challenges. Known for our speed, precision, and collaborative approach, we help clients navigate change, improve capabilities, and strengthen their competitive edge.

Hobbs Madison has established a reputation among its clients as one of the leading Strategy and IT Consultants in the U.S. for the financial services industry.

new_jobs.description:
**Location**: remote (supporting work in NV; will need to be in sync with PST working hours)

**Pay**: $120/hr (1099 contract)

**Duration**: end of Oct/beginning of Nov through June 2027, with the possibility of an extension

**Requirements:**

· 10+ years of recent Salesforce experience

· 5+ years Salesforce Platform App Builder or Salesforce Administrator experience

· Proven understanding of a full software development lifecycle. Understanding of the Salesforce product suite including Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or AppExchange solutions

· Analytical techniques - Experience leading requirements gathering sessions and documenting the outcome, including designing process flows and defining test scripts

· System configuration - Ability to design and configure a scalable Salesforce solution to meet business needs and determine when custom development is necessary

· Project management - Demonstrated analytical skills and experience with the complete lifecycle of complex enterprise projects; understanding of core project management concepts, theories, practices, and methods

· Familiarity with agile software delivery methodologies and tools such as Scrum and Agile tools such as Jira

**Preferred (Not Required) Requirements:**

· Business Analyst, Platform Developer 1, Strategy Designer, or any Architect level Salesforce certifications.

· Experience as a Quality Analyst

· Omnistudio and Flow experience

· Experience with MuleSoft, AWS tools, Box, Nintex

**Program Overview**

The Nevada Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) is undertaking a multi-year comprehensive transformation of its systems, environment, and business structure. DMV is emphasizing a complete overhaul of service offerings that focus on a new way of business. The program comprises six key initiatives, with a multi-year phased implementation through June 2029: 1) Program Organization; 2) Compliance & Enforcement Services; 3) Data Migration; 4) Financial Services; 5) Licensing & Credentials; 6) Titling & Registration. A new system to support all DMV services is being built using Salesforce, integrated with several other technologies.

**Responsibilities:**

The chosen Salesforce business analyst will operate within Agile Delivery Methodology. They will refine and deliver written tickets with solutions ready to be picked up by developers.

This role requires a self-driven individual with a “get it done” attitude and a passion to solve complex business and technology problems. You work in conjunction with the Solution Owners and Product Owners to build a solution for business needs. Depending on the nature of the project, you will be required to configure the solution or support a developer in building and testing the solution. You may also be called on to assist with activities like scoping and documentation.

When a business user/leader has issues, the BA/config is called on to help investigate, solve, or mitigate the issue to keep the business moving forward. In addition to understanding the business needs, they will be able to use configuration to solve many issues without requiring escalation to a developer.

Specific responsibilities include:

· Analyze business requirements and then recommend, implement, and manage the Salesforce solutions. Cross-platform business requirements will expose you to other tools in the environment, including AWS, MuleSoft, and other ancillary tools.

· Lead discovery sessions to gather, define, and document business requirements

· Participating in Agile ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Backlog Refinement, and Sprint Demos

· Document requirements in the form of user stories

· Demonstrate solution functionality to business stakeholders as needed

· Support user acceptance testing (UAT)

· Present solution options to the business, evaluating the pros and cons of declarative configuration against code and customization

· Participate in declarative system configuration

· Provide technical and functional expertise to project teams

· Participate in training content development and Administrator and end-user training delivery

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Salesforce: 10 years (Required)
* Salesforce Platform App Builder or Salesforce Administrator : 5 years (Required)
